core.en: Wheel of Fortune marks an active turning of the tide: conditions outside your sole control are shifting, opening a timely window. Stay centered at the hub rather than clinging to the outer rim so you ride the turn well.
core.zh: 命运之轮标志时势正在真实转向：超出个人单方掌控的大周期开始转动，推开了一扇新的时机之窗。守住圆心的定力，而不死抓不断起伏的轮缘，就能顺势借到这股东风。

message.en: The season is shifting—stay agile, spot the emerging opening early, and adapt faster than stale habits expect.
message.zh: 风向已经变了——保持轻盈敏锐，第一时间接住正在浮现的契机，别拿上一季的旧惯性去套新周期。

foundation.en: An unexpected turn of timing, serendipitous encounter, or broader cycle shift set this entire chapter in motion.
foundation.zh: 一次意料之外的时机转折、机缘际会或大环境换挡，推开了眼下这段历程。

present.en: You are standing inside a live inflection point; small choices made at the pivot carry outsized downstream leverage.
present.zh: 你正身处真实的拐点之中；转折关头落下的每一小步，都会在后续产生远超平常的放大效应。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is adaptability and timing sense—reading momentum early instead of fighting a wave you can surf.
resource.zh: 你手中最强的筹码是应变弹性与节奏感——能提前读懂潮流走向，借浪前行而非迎头硬撞。

challenge.en: Even upright, Wheel of Fortune in a challenge slot warns against banking on a lucky streak alone or assuming today's upswing runs forever without stewardship.
challenge.zh: 即便正位，落在阻碍位的命运之轮也在提醒：别把好运当成永动机，也别以为眼下的顺风期无需妥善筹谋就会一直持续。

action.en: Say yes to the timely opening in front of you while building a simple buffer for the next inevitable turn of the cycle.
action.zh: 果断接住眼前出现的时机窗口，同时顺手为下一段周期波动预留一份稳妥缓冲。

outcome.en: A decisive shift breaks stagnation—fresh momentum, serendipitous timing, or a long-awaited turn of luck moves the story onto a new arc.
outcome.zh: 清晰的转机将打破停滞——新动量、恰逢其时的契机或久候的时运转暖，会带着局面跃入全新阶段。

advice.en: Anchor yourself at the quiet hub where the wheel stays still: move swiftly with change without tying your identity to any temporary high or low.
advice.zh: 把心安放于巨轮中心不动的轴心：行动上敏捷顺应变化，心态上却不把自我价值绑在任何一时起伏上。

general.en: A meaningful turning point is underway. Stay nimble, honor good timing, and focus on what you can steer while letting larger cycles unfold.
general.zh: 一段意味深长的转折期正在展开。保持灵活身段、珍惜难得时机，抓稳自己能掌控的部分，其余交给大周期自然演进。

love.en: In love, Wheel of Fortune brings serendipitous meetings, refreshing chapter turns, or breaking out of repetitive relational loops. Welcome evolution together rather than freezing the past.
love.zh: 在感情中，命运之轮常带来奇妙缘分、关系换挡升温，或走出老套拉扯的新转机。与彼此共同拥抱成长，而非企图把关系定格在昨天。

career.en: At work, market cycles, org shifts, or fortunate timing create real openings. Position yourself visibly where momentum is rising and keep skills portable.
career.zh: 在事业上，行业周期、架构变动或恰到好处的风口正带来新机遇。尽早把自己的站位挪向势能上升处，并保持核心能力的可迁移性。

health.en: For wellbeing, notice seasonal, sleep, or energy cycles rather than expecting flat linear output every day—work with your natural peaks and recovery troughs.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，尊重季节、睡眠与精力的自然波峰波谷，别要求自己每天都像机器一样匀速满载——顺应节律调养反而更稳。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, impermanence is a teacher rather than a threat: every phase matures and yields, inviting deeper trust in the wider pattern.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，无常不是威胁而是导师：每个阶段都会盛放亦会谢幕，提醒你在更宏阔的节律中修得泰然定力。

core.en: Wheel of Fortune reversed points to friction with timing—clinging to a season that has already turned, feeling caught in a repeating pattern, or hitting unexpected external delays.
core.zh: 命运之轮逆位指向与时势节拍的错位——紧抓着早已过去的旧周期不肯松手、觉得陷入似曾相识的重复循环，或遭遇意料之外的外部延宕。

blocked.en: Resisting an inevitable shift creates far more friction than the change itself.
blocked.zh: 拼命抗拒早已不可逆转的变化，制造出的痛苦远大于变化本身。

excess.en: Gambling recklessly on luck or over-correcting wildly at every minor swing.
excess.zh: 把筹码盲目押在侥幸上，或随着每一次小波动剧烈折腾、自乱阵脚。

internalized.en: Feeling helplessly swept along by 'bad luck' while overlooking the one recurring habit keeping the loop spinning.
internalized.zh: 把一切归咎于运气不佳而感到无力，却忽略了自己手里那个不断重启旧循环的习惯。

release.en: Spotting the recurring pattern clearly enough to step off the old loop for good.
release.zh: 终于看清反复上演的旧剧本规律，彻底迈步走出那条兜圈子的老路。

challenge.en: Bad timing, stubborn attachment to how things used to work, or a familiar repeating snag is slowing you down.
challenge.zh: 时机未熟、死守过往经验，或一再重演的熟悉卡点，正在拖慢你的脚步。

action.en: Stop fighting the delay; map the repeating loop honestly, shore up what is under your control, and wait for the next clean window instead of forcing a bad bet.
action.zh: 先停止和延误硬较劲；如实画出这段反复出现的循环节点，扎紧自己能控的底盘，等下一个清晰窗口，别在逆风里强行豪赌。

outcome.en: A brief downturn or frustrating detour passes faster once you stop resisting it and update the habit that kept recreating it.
outcome.zh: 短暂的逆风或绕路只要不再硬杠、并改掉背后反复触发的旧惯性，很快便会柳暗花明。

advice.en: You cannot stop the wheel from turning, only choose how you stand while it moves—protect essentials and break one old automatic reaction.
advice.zh: 你拦不住巨轮转动，但能决定自己在转动时的站姿——护住基本盘，亲手打断一个老旧的条件反射。

general.en: External timing feels bumpy or repetitive right now. Let go of rigid scripts, avoid impulsive gambles, and change the one pattern you do control.
general.zh: 眼下外部节奏显得颠簸或似曾相识。放下死板剧本、避免意气用事的冒险，把精力集中到改写自己手里那条可控的旧模式上。

love.en: In love, reversed Wheel flags repeating the same argument or relationship script with a new face, or clinging past a natural transition. Break the familiar loop with one genuinely new response.
love.zh: 在感情中，命运之轮逆位提示旧争吵或相似的情感剧本反复重演，或不愿顺应关系的自然演进。用一个全新的真诚回应去打破老套循环。

career.en: At work, unexpected delays, shifting headwinds, or stubbornly defending an outdated playbook calls for calm contingency planning rather than panic pivots.
career.zh: 在职场上，突发延误、市场逆风或固守失效旧打法，都需要沉着预案与稳步迭代，而非慌乱折腾。

health.en: Recurring flare-ups or erratic rhythms hint at an unchanged trigger; track the cycle calmly and adjust one daily habit that keeps nudging balance off.
health.zh: 在身心层面，反复出现的疲倦或老毛病往往指向未被挪走的诱因；冷静记录节律，改掉那个一再打破平衡的日常习惯。

spirituality.en: Notice where fatalism ('nothing ever changes') excuses inaction—free will lives right inside how consciously you meet a repeating lesson.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，觉察宿命论（“反正改不了”）是否成了逃避改变的借口——自由意志就藏在你以全新觉知回应旧课题的那一念之间。

archetypeEssence.en: Clear-eyed accountability where choices, contracts, and consequences meet on level scales.
archetypeEssence.zh: 明察秋毫的公正与自省，让每一份选择、契约与后果在平稳天平上如实兑现。

en: Regal unblindfolded figure seated squarely facing forward between twin stone pillars

祖母绿金里衬的绯红丝绒披风、象牙白内袍与嵌有方形宝石的古金王冠
右手笔直竖握、刃面雪亮的一柄双刃银金长剑

core.en: Justice deals in clean cause and effect, not luck or flattery. Look squarely at the verified facts, own your share of the ledger honestly, and expect fair outcomes proportional to what was actually put on the scales.
core.zh: 正义讲的是清清楚楚的因果对等，而不是侥幸或讨好。睁大眼睛核对事实、坦荡认领账本上属于自己的那一份，最终落下的结果也会与实际投入严丝合缝。

message.en: Strip out excuses and wishful spin—weigh the plain evidence fairly and make the decision you can stand behind in daylight.
message.zh: 剥掉借口与一厢情愿的润色——把实打实的证据放上天平，做出经得起阳光检验的裁决。

foundation.en: A past agreement, legal or formal commitment, or honest cause-and-effect chain directly produced today's state of play.
foundation.zh: 过往立下的协议、正式承诺，或环环相扣的真实因果，直接造就了今天的局面。

present.en: A formal review, contract, negotiation, or decisive truth check is underway; fairness and precision carry more weight than charm.
present.zh: 一场正式评估、条款核对、谈判或关键真相校验正在进行；此刻公允与严谨远比口才讨喜更有分量。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is clean documentation and clear conscience—having the real facts, balanced terms, and honest intent on your side.
resource.zh: 你最硬的底牌是经得起查验的事实记录与坦荡立场——条款公道、证据扎实、动机清白，自然不惧审视。

challenge.en: Even upright, Justice in a challenge slot highlights the discomfort of strict accountability—owning an inconvenient consequence or keeping clinical fairness from turning icy.
challenge.zh: 即便正位，落在阻碍位的正义也指出严格问责的刺痛——不得不认领某个不轻松的后果，或避免绝对理性变得不近人情。

action.en: Read every clause twice, put the true numbers on the table, and settle one lopsided obligation cleanly before moving on.
action.zh: 把每一条细则认真重读两遍，把真实数字摊上桌面，先把一笔失衡的旧账公正了结，再谈下一步。

outcome.en: A fair verdict, clear ruling, or balanced resolution arrives—rewarding integrity directly and correcting tilted arrangements.
outcome.zh: 公道明朗的裁决、正式结论或失衡归位即将落地——坦荡付出者会得到对等回响，倾斜的安排也将被扶正。

advice.en: Keep both eyes wide open like the figure on the throne: fairness requires looking squarely at reality, not pretending bias doesn't exist.
advice.zh: 像宝座上未蒙双眼的仲裁者一样直视事实：真正的公正靠清醒审视，而不靠闭眼假装中立。

general.en: Truth, accountability, and clean equilibrium take priority. Honor commitments accurately, check formal details, and let proportional fairness guide the verdict.
general.zh: 真相、担当与清晰平衡占据主导。严谨履行承诺、核清正式细则，让不偏不倚的公允指引最终决断。

love.en: In love, Justice calls for genuine mutuality—equal voice, honest repair after mistakes, and clear agreements about commitment rather than silent scorekeeping.
love.zh: 在感情中，正义呼唤真正的对等与真诚——平等话语权、犯错后的坦诚修补，以及清晰互守的约定，而非暗中算计计分。

career.en: At work, expect formal contracts, audits, performance reviews, legal approvals, or transparent merit evaluation. Keep records airtight and negotiate terms that are fair to both sides.
career.zh: 在事业上，常对应合同签署、审计评估、绩效定级、合规审批或靠硬实力说话的评审。保留完整书面凭证，谈出对双方都站得住脚的公道条款。

health.en: For wellbeing, bodily equilibrium mirrors daily inputs directly—sleep debt, workload, and nourishment show up honestly on the ledger, inviting steady rebalancing.
health.zh: 在身心层面，身体状态正像实诚的账本一样如实映照日常投入——熬夜透支、负荷与营养都会等价显形，提醒你及时调回平衡。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, integrity is alignment between inner truth and outward deed: drop self-deception and meet consequences with quiet dignity.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，正直就是内在良知与外在行为严丝合缝：放下自我辩解，坦然承接每个选择的回声。

core.en: Justice reversed signals tilted scales—dodging accountability, encountering unfair bias, or judging yourself and others through distorted lenses rather than plain evidence.
core.zh: 正义逆位提示天平失衡——要么有人在回避应负之责、局面存在显失公允的偏倚，要么你正带着扭曲滤镜严苛评判自己或他人。

blocked.en: Delaying a necessary ruling, paperwork review, or honest admission keeps an unfair stalemate alive.
blocked.zh: 拖着该做的裁断、条款核查或坦白认错不处理，让本不公道的僵局继续发酵。

excess.en: Self-righteous rigidity—weaponizing technical rules to punish instead of seeking true fairness.
excess.zh: 自以为是的苛刻较真——拿条款细则当武器去惩罚别人，却丢掉了公允本意。

internalized.en: Holding yourself to an impossibly punitive verdict while excusing everyone else's mistakes.
internalized.zh: 对旁人处处宽容，却在心里对自己下达毫不留情的苛刻判词。

release.en: Refusing to play rigged games—stepping back from a skewed deal and restoring clean personal standards.
release.zh: 拒绝再陪失衡的局耗下去——撤出显失公平的约定，重新立稳自己的干净准则。

challenge.en: Bias, evasiveness, messy fine print, or reluctance to own a mistake is warping the outcome.
challenge.zh: 偏见、推诿、含糊条款或不肯认领失误，正在把事情引向失真走向。

action.en: Verify every missing fact independently, name the imbalance plainly on the record, and own any blind spot that belongs to you.
action.zh: 独立复核每一处被略过的事实，把不公之处清楚落到记录里，同时也干脆认领属于自己的那部分盲区。

outcome.en: Unaddressed bias or sloppy contracts linger as friction; refusing shortcuts and insisting on documented fairness eventually rights the ledger.
outcome.zh: 被敷衍过去的偏颇与漏洞只会留下后患；拒绝走捷径、坚持书面公允，账本终会逐步归平。

advice.en: Do not sign under pressure or hide behind excuses—seek neutral second eyes whenever emotions tilt the scales.
advice.zh: 切忌在催促下仓促落笔，也别拿借口替自己遮掩——当情绪让天平倾斜时，主动引入冷静中立的第三方视角。

general.en: Look closely for lopsided terms, rationalizations, or unfair judgment. Correct blind spots calmly and insist on verified facts before committing.
general.zh: 仔细排查不对等的条件、自我合理化的借口或带偏见的定论。冷静修正盲点，没核清真实证据前绝不草率拍板。

love.en: In love, reversed Justice flags uneven emotional labor, keeping resentful score, or dodging blame during conflict. Stop arguing over who is 'right' and repair actual fairness.
love.zh: 在感情中，正义逆位暴露付出失衡、翻旧账计分或在冲突中互相甩锅。停下争辩谁占理，把真正公平的相处方式修补回来。

career.en: At work, double-check contracts, credit attribution, office politics, and compliance details. Protect yourself with clear written trails rather than informal handshakes.
career.zh: 在职场上，务必反复审阅合同条款、功劳归属、团队偏倚与合规细节。用清晰可查的书面凭证护住自己，别轻信口头承诺。

health.en: Imbalanced routines or brushing off a warning sign catches up quietly; be candid with yourself about what habit is tipping the scale off center.
health.zh: 在身心层面，失衡的作息或一再敷衍的轻微不适正在暗中记账；诚实面对究竟是哪个习惯把天平压偏了。

spirituality.en: Lay down both harsh self-condemnation and subtle victimhood; honest accountability frees far more energy than guilt ever could.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，同时放下苛刻自责与隐性受害者心态；清醒坦荡的负责，比沉浸在愧疚里释放出多得多的自由。

自木梁枝节间抽出的鲜嫩绿叶，象征停顿中的生机未断
另一条腿从容曲折成数字四字形的自在姿态
双手安稳收于身后，流露自愿沉淀而非挣扎受困

自下方金环向上轻拂衣领与双肩的温润象牙金微光

core.en: The Hanged Man turns a pause into a vantage point: pushing harder right now only jams the lock. Step willingly out of urgency, look at the whole situation upside down, and trade a small short-term sacrifice for unmistakable clarity.
core.zh: 倒吊人把看似停滞的空窗转化为难得的观测位：此刻越用力硬推越容易卡死锁芯。主动从急迫感里抽身、倒转角度重看全盘，用一次有意识的小妥协换回彻底清醒的洞见。

message.en: Stop forcing movement for a beat—suspend your usual assumptions and examine this problem from the opposite angle.
message.zh: 先停下强推节奏的动作——把习以为常的前提暂时悬置，彻底站到反面视角重看这件事。

foundation.en: A deliberate pause, unexpected delay, or conscious sacrifice changed how you see what actually matters.
foundation.zh: 一次主动按下的暂停、始料未及的延宕或甘愿做出的取舍，悄然改写了你对轻重缓急的判断。

present.en: Outward progress feels slow or suspended, yet genuine internal reframing is doing quiet heavy lifting beneath the surface.
present.zh: 表面进度看似悬在半空，实则深层的观念重构正在安静发力，为你铺垫接下来的真正破局。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is patience and lateral sight—seeing a fresh exit everyone rushing at normal speed walks straight past.
resource.zh: 你手中最强的资源是沉得住气的逆向视野——能看清那些一路狂奔的人擦肩而过的隐藏出口。

challenge.en: Even upright, The Hanged Man in a challenge slot highlights the discomfort of limbo—staying calm when answers are not ready to drop into your lap yet.
challenge.zh: 即便正位，落在阻碍位的倒吊人也点出悬而未决的煎熬——当答案尚未成熟落地时，如何克制住急于硬撬的冲动。

action.en: Release one tactic that clearly isn't working, let the timeline breathe, and test the exact counter-intuitive view you dismissed earlier.
action.zh: 干脆松开那套已经证明行不通的旧打法，给时间表留出呼吸余地，去认真检验你此前一眼否掉的逆向思路。

outcome.en: An illuminating shift in perspective dissolves a stubborn knot; movement resumes later on far wiser terms than haste would have bought.
outcome.zh: 一场醍醐灌顶的视角翻转将解开死结；稍后重启推进时，你会站上比当初仓促行动高明得多的局面。

advice.en: Willing surrender is not defeat—notice the bright halo shines precisely because the traveler stopped thrashing against the rope.
advice.zh: 清醒的放手绝非认输——正因为旅人不再跟绳索徒劳撕扯，头顶那圈洞见之光才得以明亮燃起。

general.en: A constructive pause invites fresh eyes. Release brittle urgency, accept a temporary delay gracefully, and look for the overlooked angle.
general.zh: 这是一段富有价值的悬停期。松开焦躁执念，从容接住暂时的放缓，在反常规的角度里找到真正突破口。

love.en: In love, The Hanged Man asks you to pause automatic reactions and truly see through the other person's lens—or give a relationship breathing room to clarify without pressure.
love.zh: 在感情中，倒吊人提醒先按住习惯性情绪反应，真正换位体察对方眼中的世界——或给关系留出不施压的缓冲空间，让真心自然沉淀。

career.en: At work, a stalled approval, sabbatical, or strategic rethink is actually protecting you from building down the wrong corridor. Reframe the problem before doubling headcount or budget.
career.zh: 在事业上，暂缓的审批、间隔沉淀或战略重审其实是在帮你避开走偏的死胡同。先重构问题定义，别急着继续加码投入。

health.en: For wellbeing, forced rest or intentional slowdown carries a clear message: listen to recovery limits now rather than bargaining with exhaustion.
health.zh: 在身心调理上，主动放慢或被迫休整都带着清晰讯号：顺从身体的恢复节律，别再拿疲惫去硬换进度。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, letting go of ego control opens direct illumination: clarity arrives when you stop insisting reality match your old script.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，松开小我的执控才会迎来真正的开悟：当你不再要求世界照你的旧剧本演，清明的洞见自然降临。

core.en: The Hanged Man reversed exposes fruitless limbo—either stalling in martyr-like inaction long after the lesson is clear, or thrashing impatiently against a necessary pause.
core.zh: 倒吊人逆位揭示出空耗的僵持——要么早已看明白却沉溺于被动忍耐与自我牺牲迟迟不落脚，要么死活不肯接受必要缓冲、在原地焦躁挣扎。

blocked.en: Dragging out indecision under the excuse of 'waiting for clarity' when you already know the answer.
blocked.zh: 心里其实早有答案，却拿“再等等看清一点”当借口，把必要决定一拖再拖。

excess.en: Needless self-sacrifice or playing the noble martyr while quietly expecting someone else to rescue you.
excess.zh: 无谓的自我牺牲与苦情隐忍，暗中指望旁人看懂你的委屈来替你破局。

internalized.en: Restless resentment simmering underneath passive waiting.
internalized.zh: 表面一动不动地等着，内心却满是不甘与焦灼的内耗。

release.en: Cutting the cord cleanly—ending a stagnant delay and stepping back onto solid ground with your new insight.
release.zh: 干脆利落地解绳落地——结束毫无意义的空等，带着已经想通的洞见重新迈步。

challenge.en: Pointless stalling, passive martyrdom, or fighting an unavoidable wait is draining energy without adding wisdom.
challenge.zh: 毫无产出的拖延、自我感动的退让，或跟不可避免的等待硬顶，都在白白消耗心气。

action.en: End the stalemate today: stop making unnecessary sacrifices for a stuck situation and take one grounded step back onto your own feet.
action.zh: 今天就打破悬空状态：停止为停滞的局面继续做无谓牺牲，稳稳踏回实地，迈出属于自己的第一步。

outcome.en: Lingering limbo breaks open—once you stop stalling or struggling against the clock, real forward motion returns.
outcome.zh: 久拖不决的悬置期即将终结——只要停止空等或瞎急，实在的推进感会立刻接通。

advice.en: A pause stops being wise the moment it turns into avoidance; take the insight you already earned and move.
advice.zh: 一旦停顿滑向逃避，它就不再是智慧；拿好你早已悟出的那点清醒，果断落地行动。

general.en: Check whether you are hanging upside down out of genuine reflection or plain procrastination. Stop unnecessary self-sacrifice and reclaim forward agency.
general.zh: 分清此刻按兵不动究竟是真沉淀还是纯拖延。停止无谓的委屈退让，把停滞许久的主动权重新握回脚下。

love.en: In love, reversed Hanged Man warns against waiting endlessly on someone who won't meet you halfway, or sacrificing your own needs to preserve an uneasy truce.
love.zh: 在感情中，倒吊人逆位警惕无止境地单方等待一个不愿迈步的人，或靠不断委屈自己换取脆弱平静。

career.en: At work, waiting indefinitely for permission or staying stuck in a dead-end compromise wastes prime momentum. Decide whether to renegotiate terms or walk.
career.zh: 在职场上，无限期苦等批复或困在耗人的僵局妥协里只会白白折旧精力。干脆决定重谈条件，还是果断转身。

health.en: Putting off obvious care—or fighting against needed recovery time—extends the slump; take one direct practical step toward getting back on your feet.
health.zh: 在身心层面，一再推迟该做的调理，或抵触身体明确需要的休整，只会拖长低迷；今天先落实一个最直接的康复动作。

spirituality.en: Insight only matures when embodied; climb down from endless contemplation and live the perspective shift in concrete deeds.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，光想明白还不够，必须落回地面活出来；离开无止境的空想观望，用具体行动兑现你的醒悟。

archetypeEssence.en: Irreversible shedding of an outworn chapter so clean ground opens for genuine renewal.
archetypeEssence.zh: 无可挽回却清澈彻底的旧章落幕，亲手清出空地，迎接真正的新生黎明。

en: Armored skeletal knight riding calmly left-to-right astride a luminous white steed
Billowing midnight-black banner emblazoned with a glowing five-petaled white mystic rose
Fallen golden crown on the earth showing no status outlives its natural season
Figures of different ages and stations meeting the inevitable passage with varied readiness

迎风舒展、仅缀有一朵五瓣白玫瑰的漆黑丝绸战旗

core.en: Death upright marks an honest, irreversible ending—not literal doom, yet never merely cosmetic tweaking either. A role, attachment, method, or season has genuinely finished its work; honoring that close lets the sunrise between the towers actually begin.
core.zh: 死神正位宣告一段真实而不可逆的终结——它不指向字面厄运，却也绝非小修小补就能应付。某个角色、依恋、旧做法或阶段已经彻底完成使命；郑重送它谢幕，远方双塔间的日出才会真正升起。

message.en: Let what is clearly finished close cleanly; pouring fresh life into an expired form only delays the dawn already rising ahead.
message.zh: 让已经走到尽头的事干脆落幕；继续往过期的旧壳里灌注心血，只会挡住前方早已升起的晨光。

foundation.en: A profound turning point, clean farewell, or shedding of an older identity cleared the field for where you stand now.
foundation.zh: 一场彻底的告别、蜕变或旧身份的剥落，清扫出你如今所站的新地基。

present.en: You are crossing an unmistakable threshold of transformation: the old shape is dissolving in real time so a truer structure can form.
present.zh: 你正跨过一道无法回头的蜕变门槛：旧形态正在眼前真实消融，为更契合当下的新秩序腾出空间。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is ruthless honesty and clean compost—turning finished experience into rich soil instead of hoarding dead wood.
resource.zh: 你最强的力量是毫不自欺的断舍离与转化力——敢于把已结束的经历化作养分，而绝不囤积枯枝。

challenge.en: Even upright, Death in a challenge slot highlights the raw ache of letting go—grieving something once precious even when you know its season has passed.
challenge.zh: 即便正位，落在阻碍位的死神也直面放手的真实阵痛——明知花期已过，真正与曾经珍视之物作别依然需要极大勇气。

action.en: Call time formally on the outgrown habit, deal, or chapter—pack away its remnants with respect and stop negotiating with the past.
action.zh: 为那段已经不合身的旧习惯、旧合作或旧章节正式画上句号——体面收尾，不再回头和过去讨价还价。

outcome.en: A decisive chapter closes permanently, opening stark, clean air and genuine renewal on the other side of the transition.
outcome.zh: 一段旧周期将彻底封卷，穿越短暂的清空期后，迎面而来的是真正清朗且全新的开局。

advice.en: Meet transition upright with dignity rather than bargaining—the mystic white rose blooms precisely on the dark banner of release.
advice.zh: 带着尊严直面更迭而不必卑微恳求——纯白的神秘玫瑰，恰恰盛开在黑色送别之旗上。

general.en: Deep transformation requires an honest finish. Release what has outlived its purpose cleanly so genuine renewal has room to grow.
general.zh: 彻底蜕变离不开一次干脆的终结。体面放下已经完成使命的旧事物，真正的新生才拥有落脚生长的空间。

love.en: In love, Death signals a decisive chapter change—either an outgrown relational dynamic ending so both people can evolve into an honest new bond, or a clear farewell that ends lingering limbo.
love.zh: 在感情中，死神标志关系进入不可逆转的换代——要么彻底告别旧相处模式、共同长出全新阶段的亲密，要么给长期消耗的僵局画上干脆句号。

career.en: At work, expect a clean close to a role, product line, or old career identity. Sunset legacy commitments crisply so your energy flows into the next real chapter.
career.zh: 在事业上，某个岗位、业务线或旧职业定位正迎来明确收尾。果断为过时的包袱做日落退场，把精力彻底投向下一段主航道。

health.en: For wellbeing, a stale habit or draining cycle needs permanent retirement rather than half-hearted moderation; clearing what depletes you initiates real regeneration.
health.zh: 在身心层面，某个持续耗损元气的旧习或恶性作息需要彻底戒断，而非敷衍减量；清出消耗源，真正的修复再生才会启动。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, ego-shedding makes room for authenticity: every season of growth asks an older self-story to bow gracefully offstage.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，剥落陈旧的自我叙事才能显露本真：每一次深层跃迁，都要求上一阶段的“我”从容谢幕退场。

core.en: Death reversed shows resistance to an ending already underway—clinging to familiar wreckage out of fear of the blank page, or quietly undergoing slow inner metamorphosis behind closed doors.
core.zh: 死神逆位显露对必然落幕的抗拒——因畏惧空白期而紧抓早已失效的旧壳不放，或在外界尚未察觉之时，内心正经历缓慢而迟疑的蜕皮。

blocked.en: Refusing to close an expired chapter keeps you trapped in stale half-life.
blocked.zh: 迟迟不肯替已过期的阶段签字收尾，把自己困在半死不活的停滞里。

excess.en: Panicked nostalgia or frantic attempts to resuscitate a form whose life has already moved on.
excess.zh: 被怀旧与不安裹挟，拼命抢救一个早已失去生命力的空壳。

internalized.en: A quiet private transformation happening beneath outward routine before you feel ready to announce it.
internalized.zh: 外表看似一切如常，内心早已悄悄完成了对旧自己的松手与换代。

release.en: Finally loosening white-knuckled fear and allowing a delayed transition to complete gently.
release.zh: 终于松开死攥着不放的手，允许那场被拖延已久的转场温和走完最后一步。

challenge.en: Fear of the unknown is prolonging a painful goodbye that already happened in substance.
challenge.zh: 对未知空白的恐惧，正在把一场实质上早已发生的告别无限拉长。

action.en: Remove one anchor tying you to the finished past today—clear the files, cancel the zombie commitment, or speak the overdue goodbye.
action.zh: 今天就亲手拔掉一根拴在旧日里的锚——清理掉过期文档、关停名存实亡的承诺，或说出那句拖延太久的再见。

outcome.en: Change still unfolds, only slower and heavier while resisted; once you unclench your grip, relief arrives swiftly.
outcome.zh: 变革依然会发生，抗拒只会让过程更沉重漫长；一旦肯松开紧绷的手，轻盈解脱感很快就会到来。

advice.en: Stop mistaking familiarity for safety—holding onto yesterday's shell blocks the very renewal you keep wishing for.
advice.zh: 别再把熟悉误当成安全——死抱昨天的旧壳，恰恰堵死了你一直盼望的新开端。

general.en: Where are you postponing an inevitable closure out of habit or fear? Gentle acceptance turns dragged-out decay into clean renewal.
general.zh: 看看自己正因惯性或不安拖延着哪场早已注定的收尾。温和地承认并放手，能把漫长耗损立刻转为清爽重生。

love.en: In love, reversed Death flags lingering on an ex, clinging to an outdated dynamic, or fearing the vulnerability of letting a relationship evolve. Clear out past ghosts so live affection can breathe.
love.zh: 在感情中，死神逆位提示沉湎旧情、紧抓早已失灵的相处模式，或害怕关系换代带来的未知。清理过往执念，鲜活的爱才有呼吸空间。

career.en: At work, holding onto a dying role, sunken project, or outdated skill set drains future runway. Admit what has peaked and pivot deliberately while you still hold leverage.
career.zh: 在职场上，留恋走下坡路的岗位、沉没项目或过时打法只会蚕食未来空间。趁手里还有筹码，干脆认清顶点并主动转身。

health.en: Stubborn old habits keep pulling recovery backward; stop negotiating half-measures with patterns you already know drain your energy.
health.zh: 在身心层面，旧惯性总在暗中拉低恢复进度；别再和那些你明知伤神的旧习讨价还价，干脆彻底翻篇。

spirituality.en: Private inner shedding takes patience—honor quiet grief for who you used to be without chaining your future to that memory.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，内在蜕皮需要耐心——允许自己温和悼念过去的自己，却不把未来拴死在旧日回忆里。

archetypeEssence.en: Patient alchemy that blends contrasting forces, paces, and truths into a resilient middle way.
archetypeEssence.zh: 从容调和的炼金艺术，将相异的力量、节奏与立场耐心地融为稳韧的中道。

en: Serene winged angel standing with one foot on solid riverbank and one dipped in clear flowing water
Two golden chalices tilted gently as an unbroken stream of living water arcs smoothly between them
Radiant solar disk at the brow and golden triangle inside a square upon the white robe
Blooming irises lining the shoreline beside a winding sunlit path
Glowing golden sunrise crowning twin distant mountain peaks

一高一低轻倾的两只金杯，杯间一道莹亮活水自如流转

双峰之间如冠冕般洒下光辉的破晓旭日

en: Luminous Belle Epoque angel with sweeping rose-gold and crimson feathered wings balanced gracefully between mossy stone shore and shimmering cerulean pool
Flowing moonlit-ivory silk robe bearing a clean embossed antique-gold equilateral triangle inside a pale square at the chest and tiny solar disk at the brow

胸前浮雕洁净古金方内三角徽饰、额际点缀微型日轮的月白丝袍
错落轻倾、其间流淌着璀璨星光水带的两只雕花古金圣杯
水岸前景处静静盛放的蓝宝石色与鎏金鸢尾花
蜿蜒攀向远方双靛青峰间金色日出光冠的澄明山径

core.en: Temperance works like skilled metallurgy—heat and cool, push and rest, ambition and tenderness blended in exact proportion until something stronger than either extreme emerges. Take your time and calibrate with care.
core.zh: 节制如精湛淬火——在冷热、进退、雄心与温厚之间精准拿捏配比，直到两种极端融合成比任何单端都更坚韧的新质地。不急于一时，稳稳微调火候。

message.en: Skip all-or-nothing swings; the durable answer lives in blending two seemingly opposing ideas at a steady, patient pace.
message.zh: 避开非黑即白的极端摇摆；经得起时间检验的解法，藏在以耐心与分寸把两种看似对立的要素调和为一。

foundation.en: Steady moderation, thoughtful compromise, or patient healing quietly repaired rough edges and brought you here.
foundation.zh: 此前持续的克制调适、温和折中或耐心疗愈，悄悄抚平了棱角，把局面带到今天。

present.en: Integration is actively working right now—different parts of your life, skills, or team are finding a smoother shared rhythm.
present.zh: 整合正在悄然生效——你生活、能力或团队里原本割裂的几股力量，正逐步磨合出顺畅共振的节拍。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is equanimity and synthesis—the ability to bridge rival viewpoints and calm volatile situations without losing sight of purpose.
resource.zh: 你手中最宝贵的资本是定力与统筹调和力——既能弥合分歧立场、安抚急躁氛围，又始终不偏离核心目标。

challenge.en: Even upright, Temperance in a challenge slot asks whether chasing spotless harmony is keeping you over-cautious when a crisper stance is needed.
challenge.zh: 即便正位，落在阻碍位的节制也在提醒：一味追求四平八稳与面面俱到，是否让你在需要干脆表态时显得过于保守？

action.en: Test a measured blend today—combine two competing requirements in small iterative pours rather than betting everything on one extreme.
action.zh: 今天就试着做一次精准调配——用小步迭代把两项相互牵制的需求融出中间方案，别把全部筹码押在单一极端。

outcome.en: Quiet harmony, restored healing, and resilient long-term flow settle in—a sustainable synthesis built to last.
outcome.zh: 温润平顺的和谐、切实复原与细水长流的韧性将稳稳落地——这是一套能陪你走很久的持久平衡。

advice.en: Keep one foot on solid earth and one in live water: stay grounded in practical facts while staying responsive to subtle shifts.
advice.zh: 一脚踩稳实地、一脚感知活水：既紧扣现实事实，又保持对细微变化的敏锐呼应。

general.en: Balance, patience, and skillful blending steer you cleanly through complexity. Favor sustainable rhythm over dramatic bursts.
general.zh: 平衡、耐心与高超的调和力正带你安稳穿行复杂局面。把节奏拉成可持续的长跑，胜过一阵阵剧烈冲刺。

love.en: In love, Temperance brings calm mutual understanding, healing after friction, and blending two distinct lives without erasing either person. Tender patience deepens lasting intimacy.
love.zh: 在感情中，节制带来润物无声的理解、风波后的温和修补，以及既相融又不吞没彼此的舒服相处。细水长流的耐心会让亲密愈发醇厚。

career.en: At work, this excels in cross-disciplinary collaboration, diplomacy, steady iteration, and sustainable pacing. Bridge opposing teams or merge two distinct skills into an original niche.
career.zh: 在职场上，这张牌极擅长跨界整合、居中斡旋、稳步打磨与可持续交付。去连接彼此隔阂的团队，或把两种跨领域手艺融成你的独特壁垒。

health.en: For wellbeing, Temperance is genuine restoration through moderation—balanced sleep, nutrition, hydration, and steady pacing heal far better than extreme cleanses or overtraining.
health.zh: 在身心调理上，节制指向靠温和均衡换来的真修复——规律作息、均衡饮食、充分补水与适度节律，远胜极端节食或猛烈突击。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, inner alchemy happens in ordinary balance: reconciling lofty ideals with humble daily patience turns life itself into quiet sanctuary.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，内在炼金就发生在平实节制里：把高远理想与柴米油盐的耐心融为一体，日常本身便是清净道场。

core.en: Temperance reversed highlights spilled balance—swinging between extremes, rushing a process that needs slow steeping, or mixing ingredients that clash instead of harmonize.
core.zh: 节制逆位提示杯水倾洒、火候失调——要么在两个极端之间剧烈摇摆，要么急于催熟本该慢炖的进程，或硬把格格不入的要素凑在一起引发内耗。

blocked.en: Impatience interrupts a delicate blend before it has time to settle.
blocked.zh: 沉不住气的急躁，在局面还没来得及融合沉淀前就亲手打乱了火候。

excess.en: Overindulgence, overwork, or extreme swings from strict austerity straight into burnout bingeing.
excess.zh: 过度放纵、超负荷透支，或在严苛苦行与报复性失控之间来回猛摆。

internalized.en: Feeling subtly out of tune inside—splitting energy across clashing priorities without noticing the leak.
internalized.zh: 内心隐约觉得别扭失谐——精力被互相打架的事项悄悄耗空，却没察觉缺口在哪里。

release.en: Spotting the imbalance early and returning deliberately to simpler, calmer proportions.
release.zh: 及时觉察失衡苗头，主动删繁就简，把生活与工作重新拉回清简舒适的比例。

challenge.en: Impatience, excess, or incompatible commitments are throwing your natural rhythm off center.
challenge.zh: 急躁催进度、过度消耗或互相冲突的安排，正把你原本稳当的节律彻底打乱。

action.en: Cut one extreme habit immediately—dial intensity back from ten to six and separate two clashing tasks instead of forcing them together.
action.zh: 立刻叫停一个走到极端的习惯——把强度从十分降回六分，并把两件彼此掣肘的事拆开处理，别再硬往一锅里熬。

outcome.en: Rushing or over-swinging spills effort; stepping back to simplify restores clean footing quickly.
outcome.zh: 越急躁越容易打翻手里的积累；肯主动退回简单比例，稳当的节奏很快就会重新合拍。

advice.en: Aim for steady middle ground today—boring consistency heals faster than dramatic resets.
advice.zh: 今天只求稳稳站在中间地带——看似平淡的持续微调，比轰轰烈烈的推倒重来管用得多。

general.en: Notice where impatience, excess, or competing priorities have knocked equilibrium loose. Pare back extremes and let pace settle before adding anything new.
general.zh: 留意急躁、过度投入或互相抵消的安排从哪里撬松了平衡。先砍掉极端项，让节奏稳住后再考虑加新内容。

love.en: In love, reversed Temperance flags hot-and-cold swings, hasty reactions, or clashing lifestyles pulling partners apart. Slow the temperature down and re-negotiate daily rhythm gently.
love.zh: 在感情中，节制逆位提示忽冷忽热、脱口而出的急躁反应，或生活步调失和带来的摩擦。先给情绪降温，再温和磨合日常节拍。

career.en: At work, boom-and-bust sprints, poor cross-team alignment, or conflicting goals waste energy. Strip down competing priorities and restore predictable cadence.
career.zh: 在职场上，一阵狂熬一阵瘫痪的脉冲式节奏、跨组内耗或目标打架正在空耗效率。精简冲突项，重新建立可预期的工作节律。

health.en: Overstimulation, erratic meals/sleep, or yo-yo habits are taxing your system; return immediately to plain, steady daily basics.
health.zh: 在身心层面，过度刺激、紊乱的三餐睡眠或忽松忽紧的摇摆习惯正在透支底子；立刻回归朴素平稳的日常基础养护。

spirituality.en: Impatience with gradual inner growth breeds restlessness; stop chasing peak moments and re-anchor in calm ordinary presence.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，对渐进成长失去耐心只会催生浮躁；不再追逐强烈高峰体验，重新安住在平淡清明的当下。

archetypeEssence.en: Compulsive attachment, appetite, and self-forged chains whose loops remain looser than fear admits.
archetypeEssence.zh: 沉溺执念、欲望牵引与自我套上的枷锁——看似沉重难逃，锁环其实比恐惧宣称的更松。

en: Horned bat-winged shadow figure perched imposingly atop a dark stone pedestal
Inverted five-pointed star gleaming above its brow as matter ruling spirit
Right hand raised open while the left tilts a blazing torch downward toward appetite
Two human figures standing below loosely tethered by wide metal collars to a central plinth ring
Small horns and flame-or-grape motifs on the captives showing willing entanglement with habit
zh: 踞于暗石基座之上、生有羊角与蝠翼的威严暗影恶魔
悬于额际的倒五芒星，喻示物欲凌驾于清明觉知之上

基座下颈套宽大铁环、以松弛锁链系于中央石环的两位男女
二人隐现的细小犄角与火穗葡藤纹饰，揭示半推半就的惯性依附

Glowing antique-gold inverted five-pointed star gleaming between curved ram horns above piercing amber eyes
Left hand tilting a blazing vermilion-gold torch downward casting fiery chiaroscuro across the midnight void
Two luminous human figures standing below in dark silk drapery wearing conspicuously loose gilded iron collars and slack chains looped to a central bronze ring
Fierce molten-ember torchlight carving stark contrast between obsidian shadows and smoky ivory highlights
zh: 踞于黑曜石高台之上、展开嵌金暗蝠翼与弯曲羊角的威严暗影君主
双角之间泛着冷冽金光的倒五芒星与锐利琥珀眼眸
左手倒举炽烈朱金火把，在漆黑夜渊中投下强烈明暗火光
基座下身披暗色丝绸、颈间套着明显宽大松弛的金铁锁环与松垂链条的两道人影
熔金余烬火光劈开深靛黑影与烟白高光的凌厉戏剧质感

core.en: The Devil upright confronts entanglement honestly: a compulsion, gilded trap, toxic loop, or appetite has started running the show. Look closely at the collars—the chain feels heavy because you keep agreeing to stand inside it, not because the lock is welded shut.
core.zh: 恶魔正位直面真实的执念与困局：某种成瘾惯性、利益诱惑、耗人关系或欲念正在反客为主。仔细看清颈间那圈锁环——让你寸步难行的往往不是焊死的铁链，而是出于恐惧、贪恋或不甘所默许的停留。

message.en: Name the exact hook holding you here—comfort, status, validation, or compulsion—because unexamined appetites run you in the dark.
message.zh: 把此刻拴住你的那个真实钩子直白点出名来——安逸、虚荣、讨好还是惯性沉溺——藏在暗处的欲望才会暗中操纵你。

foundation.en: A tempting bargain, short-term indulgence, or unexamined dependency quietly locked in the constraints you are wrestling with now.
foundation.zh: 过往一笔看似诱人的交易、放纵惯性或未经省察的依赖，悄悄织成了今天束手束脚的困局。

present.en: You are standing inside a magnetic pull that costs more freedom than it admits; awareness of the trap is the exact crack that loosens it.
present.zh: 你正身处一股极具诱惑却暗暗索要自由代价的牵引力里；清醒看穿它的运作机制，就是松开枷锁的第一道裂缝。

resource.en: Even here, raw drive and fierce clarity about what people actually want can become potent leverage—provided you stay master of the appetite instead of its servant.
resource.zh: 即便在这张牌上，炽热的野心、直面人性欲望的清醒眼光仍是强悍筹码——前提是由你驾驭欲念，绝不沦为它的奴仆。

challenge.en: Compulsive habits, gilded handcuffs, codependent bonds, or shadow fears are holding you captive inside a cage whose door isn't even locked.
challenge.zh: 成瘾式惯性、金手铐式的现实绑架、共生依附或隐秘恐惧，正把你困在一座其实并未落锁的牢笼里。

action.en: Interrupt one automatic craving or draining deal today—lift the loose collar deliberately and prove to yourself you can walk ten steps away.
action.zh: 今天就亲手打断一个习以为常的沉溺动作或耗人交易——主动摘下那副松垮的锁环，向自己证明你随时能走出十步之外。

outcome.en: Unchecked entanglement tightens into deeper exhaustion or regret; naming the bargain plainly exposes the loose chain so you can choose freedom.
outcome.zh: 若继续放任沉溺，束缚只会越收越紧、透支心神；唯有坦诚揭开这笔代价账，松开的链环才真正交回你手里。

advice.en: Stop blaming the pedestal or pretending you have no choice—humorous, fearless honesty about your own shadow breaks its spell immediately.
advice.zh: 别再把一切怪给外界诱惑或假装身不由己——带着清醒甚至一点自嘲去直视自己的欲望弱点，魔咒当下就会失灵。

general.en: Examine where convenience, craving, fear, or status has traded away your autonomy. Naming the hidden strings restores real choice.
general.zh: 诚实审视自己是否在安逸、欲念、恐惧或体面名义下交出了自主权。看清那些暗中牵线的细绳，选择权才会重新回到你手里。

love.en: In love, The Devil exposes intense magnetism tangled with possessiveness, jealousy, codependency, or repeating toxic cycles. Tell the truth about whether desire is nourishing both of you or draining self-respect.
love.zh: 在感情中，恶魔直指强烈吸引背后缠绕的占有欲、嫉妒、情绪捆绑或明知耗人却反复纠缠的循环。坦白问自己：这份悸动是在滋养彼此，还是在掏空尊严？

career.en: At work, watch for golden handcuffs, toxic overwork rewarded by prestige, predatory terms, or chasing short-term gain at the expense of integrity. Audit what the paycheck or title actually costs you.
career.zh: 在职场上，警惕金手铐陷阱、靠透支换光环的病态内卷、苛刻捆绑条款，或为短期利益押上操守。算清这份薪水与头衔背后真正的隐性代价。

health.en: For wellbeing, look candidly at numbing habits, compulsive scrolling, substance or stress loops, and overextension; real care starts by admitting what is running on autopilot.
health.zh: 在身心层面，坦诚面对用来麻痹压力的成瘾习惯、深夜刷屏、过量刺激或停不下来的透支循环；真正的照顾始于不再替惯性找借口。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, shadow work refuses polite denial: own your hunger, envy, and fear without shame so they stop steering your life from the basement.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，阴影功课拒绝礼貌粉饰：坦荡认领内心的贪恋、嫉妒与恐惧，不羞耻也不放纵，它们才不再躲在地下室暗中掌舵。

core.en: The Devil reversed marks the moment the loose collar lifts off—breaking free from a draining loop, outgrowing an old temptation, or finally confronting a hidden compulsion you kept secret.
core.zh: 恶魔逆位标志松动枷锁的觉醒时刻——正从消耗人的惯性、诱惑或捆绑关系里抽身脱困，或终于不再掩饰那个长久藏在暗处的执念。

blocked.en: Seeing the trap clearly yet hesitating to step completely away from its familiar comfort.
blocked.zh: 明明已经看穿困局，却仍贪恋那一丝熟悉感而迟迟不肯彻底迈步离开。

excess.en: Hiding compulsive patterns deeper underground where shame keeps them harder to dismantle.
excess.zh: 把沉溺习惯藏得更深，羞耻感反而让它更难被摊开拆解。

internalized.en: Quiet private resolve forming—realizing a fear or craving simply lost its old hold over you.
internalized.zh: 内心悄然生出清醒定力——突然发现从前牵着你走的恐惧或诱惑，如今已不再奏效。

release.en: Slipping the chain cleanly over your head and reclaiming your time, boundaries, and self-respect.
release.zh: 利落地把松垮铁环从头顶摘下，重新夺回属于自己的时间、边界与自尊。

challenge.en: The final tug of an old habit or guilt from past entanglement is testing whether your breakaway holds.
challenge.zh: 旧惯性的最后一波回潮，或过往沉溺留下的愧疚，正在考验你的抽身是否足够坚定。

action.en: Remove the trigger environment today—unsubscribe, set a firm boundary, tell an honest confidant, and replace the empty slot with a clean habit.
action.zh: 今天就从环境里拆掉诱发源——彻底切断旧入口、立下硬边界、向信得过的人坦白立约，并用清爽的新习惯填补空位。

outcome.en: Genuine liberation takes hold: an unhealthy attachment loosens decisively and energy once spent wrestling temptation returns to your own goals.
outcome.zh: 切实的松绑与重获自由即将落地：消耗你的执念彻底松脱，原本耗在对抗诱惑里的精力全数回到自己的人生主线。

advice.en: Walk cleanly away without turning liberation into self-punishment; reclaiming freedom feels lighter than nursing regret.
advice.zh: 干脆往前走，别把戒断变成自我惩罚；坦然拥抱重获的自由，远比反复咀嚼懊悔更有力量。

general.en: Detachment and regained agency are within reach. Slip the old chain deliberately and protect your newly cleared boundaries.
general.zh: 抽离与重掌主动权已触手可及。果断摘下那副早该松开的旧链环，并用心护住刚刚清出来的健康边界。

love.en: In love, reversed Devil points to breaking free from toxic push-pull dynamics, ending unhealthy attachment, or rebuilding a bond on honest autonomy instead of control.
love.zh: 在感情中，恶魔逆位指向走出耗人的拉扯博弈、斩断不健康依附，或卸下控制欲，在彼此独立坦诚的基础上重建关系。

career.en: At work, stepping away from golden handcuffs, renegotiating exploitative terms, or ditching burnout workaholism restores real sovereignty over your craft.
career.zh: 在职场上，摆脱金手铐束缚、重谈苛刻条款或戒掉靠焦虑驱动的工作狂模式，让你重新拿回对事业的主权。

health.en: Breaking an exhausting habit loop or seeking real support for compulsive stress patterns opens steady physical and emotional relief.
health.zh: 在身心层面，打破耗人的成瘾惯性，或正视压力代偿并寻求切实帮助，会带来肉眼可见的轻松与元气回流。

spirituality.en: Shadow integration yields quiet dignity: once you stop hiding your flaws or fearing temptation, inner sovereignty becomes effortless.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，整合阴影带来沉静自尊：当你不再藏匿弱点、也不再惧怕诱惑，内在主权便水到渠成。

promptSpec.suitAccent: molten ember-vermilion torchlight, burnished bronze-gold, obsidian shadows, warm smoky ivory highlights, deep midnight-indigo void
promptSpec.scene: Perched imposing atop a carved obsidian pedestal against a velvety midnight-indigo abyss, ONE majestic horned Art Nouveau shadow entity with sweeping dark-leather and antique-gold bat wings stares forward with piercing amber eyes beneath ONE small glowing antique-gold inverted five-pointed star suspended between its curved ram horns. Its right hand lifts open in stark silhouette while its left hand tilts ONE blazing vermilion-gold torch downward, casting dramatic molten firelight across the dark stone chamber. Standing below the pedestal are TWO luminous human figures clad in subtle dark twilight silk drapery, each wearing a conspicuously loose gilded iron collar and slack chain looped to a central bronze ring on the stone plinth—wide enough to lift effortlessly over their heads—accented with delicate gilded tiny horn-filigree and vine/ember motifs. Fierce torchlit chiaroscuro separates the horned winged sovereign, blazing downward flame, and loosely chained figures with arresting psychological clarity.

requiredObjects.object: horned bat-winged Devil entity perched on stone pedestal
downward blazing vermilion-gold torch in left hand
loosely chained human figures standing below pedestal
obsidian stone pedestal with central bronze ring

promptSpec.compositionNote: Commanding dark triangular silhouette of horned winged entity crowning the pedestal above twin torch-lit figures linked by bright slack gold chains—unmistakable dramatic contrast and iconography even at 64x96 thumbnail.

archetypeEssence.en: Sudden structural truth that collapses a fragile facade so solid ground can be seen.
archetypeEssence.zh: 骤然降临的真相闪电，震塌原本摇摇欲坠的假象，让人重新看清坚实地面。

en: Tall stone tower struck by a bright bolt of lightning from a dark sky
Gilded crown blown cleanly off the tower's summit
Flames bursting from high windows as brittle masonry gives way
Figures thrown outward into open air as the old shelter breaks
zh: 漆黑夜空中劈中石塔的耀眼闪电
自塔顶被震落的金冠
自高窗喷涌而出的火光与崩落的砖石
旧庇护瓦解时跃出半空的身影

en: Tall gray-stone Art Nouveau observatory spire perched on a midnight sea-crag, cleaved at the summit by molten white-gold lightning
Ornate antique-gold spire crown lifted aloft amid golden sparks and tumbling masonry shards
Warm amber-gold light radiating from three arched windows as two robed travelers look upward from rocky steps
Parting storm clouds behind the broken pinnacle revealing a calm, crystal-clear starry midnight-indigo sky
zh: 矗立于午夜海崖之上的灰石新艺术尖塔，塔顶被白金色闪电骤然劈开
被冲击掀离塔顶的鎏金冠冕、飞溅金芒与崩落的雕花石块
三扇拱窗透出炽热琥珀火光，崖阶上两位旅人仰望骤变瞬间
裂开的塔顶后方乌云散去，露出一片清澈沉静的深蓝星空

core.en: The Tower upright is a disruptive awakening, not comfortable smoothness: an unstable assumption, role, or structure cracks open abruptly so you can stop defending what could not hold.
core.zh: 高塔正位绝非风平浪静的顺境，而是一次剧烈却清醒的破局：原本就撑不住的假设、角色或结构骤然裂开，逼着你不再维护注定失效的外壳。

outcome.en: Expect a sharp shake-up or undeniable revelation that clears away brittle plans; what survives the jolt is what was genuinely real.
outcome.zh: 前方可能出现一次干脆利落的震荡或无法回避的真相揭露，冲垮脆弱安排；熬过冲击留下的才是真正靠得住的东西。

challenge.en: Clinging to a structure that is already cracking multiplies the shock; let go of the facade before it falls on your head.
challenge.zh: 死守已经开裂的结构只会放大冲击；在旧壳砸下来前先主动撤离。

action.en: Name the flaw nobody wants to admit and dismantle the weakest dependency deliberately rather than waiting for an uncontrolled break.
action.zh: 主动指出那个大家都不愿承认的隐患，有计划地拆掉最脆弱的依赖，而不是坐等它失控崩塌。

general.en: Sudden disruption clears away an unsustainable illusion. It feels jarring in the moment, yet opens honest ground for rebuilding on truth.
general.zh: 突如其来的震荡正在清扫难以维系的假象。当下确实刺痛颠簸，却为你在真实地基上重建腾出了空间。

love.en: In love, a blunt truth or abrupt turning point breaks an unspoken facade. Honest rebuilding is only possible once pretense stops.
love.zh: 在感情里，一句无法再遮掩的真相或骤变打破了表面默契。只有停止粉饰，关系或个人才可能真正重建。

career.en: At work, anticipate sudden restructuring, a failed assumption, or a hard pivot. Protect essentials and pivot fast rather than defending sunk costs.
career.zh: 在事业上，做好应对突发变动、关键假设失效或硬着陆转向的准备。保住核心底牌、迅速止损转向，切忌恋战沉没成本。

health.en: A sharp wake-up call around ignored stress or limits; take sudden warning signs seriously and reset immediately.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，身体正对长期被忽视的压力与透支发出尖锐警报；请认真对待突发的疲惫或不适信号，并立刻调整作息与负荷。

spirituality.en: Ego defenses shatter so unvarnished reality can breathe; painful clarity is still liberation.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，自我筑起的防御高墙骤然松动倒塌，赤裸而清冽的真实得以透进空气；尽管伴随阵痛，这份清醒同样是一场松绑。

core.en: The Tower reversed indicates an internal quake or delayed upheaval—either you are cushioning a necessary change, or desperately propping up walls that still need to come down.
core.zh: 高塔逆位指向内在震荡或被延后的剧变——要么你正在把必要变革拆小缓冲，要么仍在苦苦支撑早该拆除的危墙。

blocked.en: Postponing an inevitable breakup, resignation, or structural fix only drags out anxiety.
blocked.zh: 一再拖延迟早要做的告别、转向或结构性修补，只会拉长焦虑。

internalized.en: A quiet private paradigm shift happening beneath an outwardly calm surface.
internalized.zh: 外表风平浪静，内心却正经历一场彻底的观念重塑。

excess.en: Bracing for catastrophe everywhere even after the actual risk has passed.
excess.zh: 风波已过却仍草木皆兵，处处防备塌方。

release.en: A controlled demolition—dismantling what no longer fits on your own terms.
release.zh: 一次可控拆解——按自己的节奏撤掉不再合身的结构。

general.en: Notice where fear of disruption is keeping you inside a cramped status quo. Controlled change now prevents a rougher break later.
general.zh: 高塔逆位提醒你留意对动荡的恐惧是否正把你困在早已逼仄的现状里。现在主动分步拆改，能避免日后被动承受更剧烈的断裂。

love.en: An unspoken tension is simmering beneath polite routine; address the crack gently before it forces a blow-up.
love.zh: 在感情中，表面体面的日常下可能压着早已存在却未说破的裂痕；趁彼此还能温和对话时主动修补或坦白，比继续回避更稳妥。

career.en: A narrow miss or quiet warning exposes a brittle process—use the reprieve to refactor before the real deadline hits.
career.zh: 在职场上，一次险些酿成事故的预警已经暴露了流程或架构里的脆弱环节——趁眼下仍有缓冲窗口，立刻加固防线或推进转型。

health.en: Early stress signals are giving you a chance to adjust before burnout peaks.
health.zh: 在身心层面，早期疲惫与轻微不适信号其实给了你提前刹车的珍贵机会，趁尚未彻底过载前调整节奏，远比硬撑到崩盘划算。

spirituality.en: Deep beliefs are quietly reorganizing from within without needing outer drama.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，一场静悄悄的内在信念重排正在发生——无需等待外部剧烈风波，你就能主动松开那些早已不再契合的旧执念。

promptSpec.suitAccent: blinding ivory-gold lightning, molten vermilion flame, storm-slate granite, burnished antique gold, deep midnight-indigo night sky
promptSpec.scene: Rising steeply upon a jagged obsidian sea-crag at midnight, ONE tall cylindrical gray-stone Art Nouveau observatory spire is struck cleanly at its pinnacle by ONE brilliant jagged bolt of molten white-gold celestial lightning descending diagonally from parting storm clouds. The dramatic lightning flash lifts ONE ornate antique-gold spire crown aloft into the night amid shimmering golden sparks and tumbling carved masonry stones, while warm amber-gold light glows from three tall arched windows. Below on the winding rocky cliffside steps, TWO stylized Belle Epoque travelers in billowing ivory and crimson cloaks look upward in sudden awe as the weathered structure cracks open. Directly behind the broken summit, storm clouds part to reveal a tranquil, crystal-clear expanse of deep starry midnight-indigo sky.

requiredObjects.object: tall stone tower perched on rocky peak
blinding lightning bolt striking tower summit
dislodged golden crown flying off tower top
figures leaping outward into midnight air

promptSpec.compositionNote: Strong vertical stone tower shaft cut across the upper third by a bright diagonal white-gold lightning bolt and airborne crown silhouette, backed by parting dark clouds and clear starry sky—unmistakably dramatic at 64x96 thumbnail.

archetypeEssence.en: Quiet restoration, unguarded hope, and steady celestial guidance after the storm has passed.
archetypeEssence.zh: 风暴散尽后的清澈疗愈与真诚盼望，在静谧星光下重新接通笃定的内在指引。

en: Graceful water-bearer kneeling with one knee on earth and one foot touching a clear tranquil pool
Two vessels pouring sparkling water—one returning to the pool and one feeding five streams across the land
One radiant large eight-pointed golden star shining overhead surrounded by seven smaller eight-pointed stars
Open unguarded posture beneath a vast calm night sky signaling sincerity and renewal
Lone ibis bird perched serenely atop a distant hill tree
zh: 一膝点地、一足轻触澄澈静水的倾水女神
双手各执一只水瓶，一瓶回注池水，一瓶化作五道清流润泽大地
澄朗夜空中最明亮的一颗八芒主星与环绕其侧的七颗小八芒星
在静谧天幕下毫无防备、舒展敞开的姿态，象征坦诚与疗愈
远处小丘树梢上静静栖息的一只圣鹮飞鸟

en: Luminous Belle Epoque figure draped delicately in gossamer translucent pearl-ivory silk kneeling beside a mirror-still cerulean pool
Exactly two antique-gold amphorae tilted gracefully to pour sparkling liquid starlight back into the water and across five silver rills on the mossy bank
One radiant large eight-pointed molten-gold star blazing overhead surrounded cleanly by exactly seven smaller glowing eight-pointed ivory-gold stars
Low midnight-indigo hillside in the distance crowned with a slender cypress tree holding one small perched ivory ibis bird
Serene starlit high-key illumination bathing water ripples, flowing silk, and open starry expanse in restorative calm
zh: 轻披半透珠白薄纱、跪坐于如镜天蓝星池畔的美好年代倾水者
双手轻倾的两只古金双耳陶瓶，将莹亮星光清流分别注回水池与岸边五道银溪
深邃午夜蓝天穹正中闪耀的一颗硕大熔金八芒星与周围清晰分布的七颗小八芒星
远山剪影中纤细柏树枝头静栖的一只象牙白飞鸟
轻洒在水波、轻纱与苍穹之间、澄澈安抚的清朗星辉

core.en: The Star arrives like cool clean air after lightning clears the sky: healing is genuine, hope has honest footing again, and pouring yourself out sincerely replenishes you instead of emptying the well.
core.zh: 星星宛如雷雨骤歇后涌进胸腔的清凉空气：疗愈真实发生，希望重新有了脚踏实地的根基；此刻坦诚流露与默默耕耘不会把你掏空，反而会让你越活越丰盈。

message.en: Trust the quiet clearing ahead—keep showing up with unguarded sincerity, because steady renewal is already underway.
message.zh: 信任眼前这片渐渐放晴的夜空——继续怀着不设防的真诚向前走，温和而踏实的修复已经在发生了。

foundation.en: Surviving a past shake-up stripped away pretense and left you anchored in a cleaner, truer sense of purpose.
foundation.zh: 熬过此前的震荡洗礼后，虚饰尽数剥落，让你反而站稳在更纯粹清晰的初心之上。

present.en: You are in a restorative window of clarity and inspiration; creative energy flows gently without frantic strain.
present.zh: 你正身处澄明而有灵气的修复窗口；灵感与好状态正柔和回流，不再需要咬牙硬逼。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is authentic vision and calm goodwill—people trust a steady guiding light that does not clamor for applause.
resource.zh: 你最宝贵的资源是真诚长远的愿景与温润定力——人们天然信任一束不喧哗却始终稳定的指路星光。

challenge.en: Even upright, The Star in a challenge slot cautions against drifting solely in lofty inspiration without channeling at least one bright stream onto practical earth.
challenge.zh: 即便正位，落在阻碍位的星星也在提醒：别只停留在仰望星空的理想微光里，记得把其中一股清泉实实在在浇灌到现实土壤上。

action.en: Share one honest piece of work, express real gratitude, and invest daily steady care in the long-term dream that genuinely moves you.
action.zh: 拿出一样真诚不炫技的作品与世界分享，表达由衷的感谢，并把日常稳定的心血浇灌在真正打动你的长期愿景上。

outcome.en: Deep healing, renewed faith, and luminous alignment unfold—a calm, sustainable chapter built on clear direction.
outcome.zh: 深层疗愈、重燃的笃定信念与顺遂契合将温和展开——一段方向清晰、细水长流的好时光正在铺陈。

advice.en: Pour equally into inner life and outer earth—keep your heart open while anchoring bright ideals in simple repeatable craft.
advice.zh: 把水同时注进内在池水与外在土地——既保持心门敞开，也把清亮理想落进朴素可坚持的日常功夫。

general.en: Hope, clarity, and gentle regeneration guide this period. Follow your truest north star patiently; what was shaken is mending cleanly.
general.zh: 希望、澄明与温和再生引领这段时期。耐心追随内心最诚实的北极星，曾经动荡的部分正在清澈愈合。

love.en: In love, The Star brings unguarded tenderness, healing after heartbreak or strain, and quiet devotion where both people feel safe simply being themselves.
love.zh: 在感情中，星星带来不设防的温柔、伤痛之后的真切复原，以及不必伪装讨好、只需做真实自己便能彼此相惜的安稳情意。

career.en: At work, this favors meaningful vocation, fresh creative inspiration, reputation renewal, and long-horizon projects aligned with your authentic voice.
career.zh: 在事业上，极为有利呼应志业初心的方向、清澈创作灵感、口碑修复，以及与个人真实声音高度契合的长期作品。

health.en: For wellbeing, steady recuperation and nervous-system calm take hold—gentle hydration, restorative sleep, and hopeful consistency rebuild deep vitality.
health.zh: 在身心调理上，踏实的康复与内在安宁正在生效——温和补水、舒心深睡与充满盼望的平稳节律会悄悄养回深层元气。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, grace feels quiet and unmistakable: you are connected to a wider sky, guided without force, and invited to shine simply by staying true.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，恩典安静而确凿：你与辽阔苍穹自然相连，不必强求外力，只要忠于本真本身就能散发安稳微光。

core.en: The Star reversed reflects dimmed faith—feeling discouraged when recovery takes longer than hoped, losing touch with your creative spark, or slipping into guarded cynicism after disappointment.
core.zh: 星星逆位映照出星光暂暗的心境——当复原比预期慢而心生泄气、与灵感暂时失联，或受挫后滑向用冷漠防备保护自己的低潮。

blocked.en: Discouragement or quiet burnout makes the horizon look farther away than it actually is.
blocked.zh: 倦怠与泄气让原本已在靠近的曙光，在眼里显得遥不可及。

excess.en: Chasing unattainable perfection or starry fantasy while overlooking concrete small wins already at your feet.
excess.zh: 执着于遥不可及的完美幻想，却忽略了脚边早已生出的具体小进展。

internalized.en: Privately nursing faded hope while putting on a brave, unbothered front.
internalized.zh: 外表装作云淡风轻，内心却在默默消化失落与对未来的不确定感。

release.en: Letting go of bruised cynicism so quiet, grounded optimism can gently relight.
release.zh: 放下受伤后筑起的悲观硬壳，让踏实温和的微光重新在心里点亮。

challenge.en: Loss of faith, creative dryness, or measuring yourself against a harsh ideal is dimming your momentum.
challenge.zh: 信心滑落、灵感枯竭，或拿过于苛刻的理想标尺鞭策自己，正在压暗你的前行动力。

action.en: Refill your own pitcher first—step back from comparison, acknowledge one honest small victory, and reconnect with something that quietly delights you.
action.zh: 先往自己的水瓶里重新蓄水——关掉横向比较，认真承认一个实实在在的小进步，去做一件纯粹让你眼里有光的小事。

outcome.en: Disillusionment softens as soon as you stop demanding instant miracles; quiet trust returns step by ordinary step.
outcome.zh: 当你不再苛求一夜奇迹，失落感就会迅速松动；踏实的信任感会在平凡一步步里重新长回来。

advice.en: Stars do not vanish behind clouds—lower the bar from grand inspiration to gentle daily stewardship until the sky clears.
advice.zh: 云层遮住夜空时星星并未消失——先别逼自己立刻灵感迸发，温和守好每一天的细小照料，天色自会放晴。

general.en: Tend quiet discouragement honestly instead of forcing fake cheer. Small restorative routines and modest grounded hopes bring back genuine clarity.
general.zh: 诚实照顾心底的失落与疲乏，不必强颜欢笑装作充满干劲。微小的修复日常与脚踏实地的盼望，很快会带回真正清澈的心境。

love.en: In love, reversed Star shows guarded trust after old hurt, fading spark from routine neglect, or unrealistic pedestals. Gentle honesty and small acts of care rekindle warmth.
love.zh: 在感情中，星星逆位提示旧伤留下的防备心、疏于经营导致的平淡，或过高的完美滤镜。用真诚沟通与细水长流的小体贴重新点亮暖意。

career.en: At work, disconnection from purpose or creative fatigue signals it is time to reconnect with why the craft mattered to you—or reassess a path that no longer inspires honest effort.
career.zh: 在职场上，失去意义感或创意疲倦都在提醒：重新找回这份工作最初打动你的缘由，或冷静评估这条路是否仍值得你倾注热情。

health.en: Low morale can make physical care feel pointless; pick the gentlest baseline habit—sleep, water, daylight—and let steady care lift spirits first.
health.zh: 在身心层面，情绪低落容易让人懒得照料身体；先守住最轻巧的基础三件套——睡眠、饮水、晒太阳——让稳步养护先托住心气。

spirituality.en: Dry seasons are part of real growth, not abandonment; stay gentle with doubt and trust that meaning returns more deeply when unforced.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，暂时的枯水期本就是成长的一部分，绝非被遗忘；温柔接纳怀疑，不急不逼，深层的笃定感反而会更醇厚地回归。

promptSpec.suitAccent: radiant starlight gold, luminous cerulean-aqua water, moonlit pearl-ivory, velvety midnight-indigo sky

requiredObjects.object: kneeling luminous water-bearer figure
gilded amphora vessels pouring water
large central eight-pointed golden star
smaller eight-pointed golden stars surrounding the central star
small ivory ibis bird perched in distant tree

avoid: extra background stars making star count ambiguous

archetypeEssence.en: Walking steady through twilight uncertainty, vivid dreams, and instinctual tides without mistaking shadows for facts.
archetypeEssence.zh: 穿行于月夜迷雾、潜意识梦境与本能暗流之中，保持脚步稳健而不把影子误认作实情。

en: Luminous full moon enclosing a serene crescent profile beaming rays and falling light-droplets
Winding pale pathway rising out of a dark pool toward distant mysterious mountains
Crayfish emerging steadily from dark waters representing primal instincts surfacing into awareness
Wild wolf and domesticated hound howling on opposite sides of the path at the glowing moon
Twin tall stone watchtowers flanking the narrow threshold into the unknown hills
zh: 悬于夜空、映着沉静侧颜月相并洒下光束与金滴的满月
自幽深水池延伸而出、蜿蜒通往远山的苍白小径
从暗水缓缓爬上岸边的螯虾，象征潜意识本能浮出水面
分立小径两侧、仰首望月长鸣的野狼与家犬
矗立在荒野入口两侧、守护未知边界的两座高耸石塔

en: Radiant pale-gold full moon delicately etched with a serene sleeping crescent profile casting shimmering silver rays and fifteen golden light-droplets
Articulated bronze-gold crayfish crawling out of a reflective dark lotus pool in the foreground toward a narrow moonlit path
Two attentive canines flanking the winding path—one shadowed indigo-furred wild wolf on the left and one sleek silver-ivory hound on the right howling skyward
Two symmetrical pale-limestone watchtowers standing starkly against violet-indigo mist framing distant mountain peaks
Dreamlike silver-violet and molten-gold chiaroscuro illuminating misty water, twin towers, and celestial rays
zh: 夜空正中刻画着宁静侧颜弯月轮廓、洒下银辉与十五点金露的淡金满月
前景暗莲池中缓缓爬向月光小径的古铜金螯虾
小径左右仰望明月的一匹靛影野狼与一只银白家犬
矗立在银紫薄雾中、夹道通往远山的两座对称浅灰石塔
在午夜阴影中交织银紫月华与古金微光的梦境明暗层次

core.en: The Moon illuminates a landscape where visibility is genuinely low: vivid intuition and old anxieties share the same moonlight, and shapes in the mist look larger than they are. Keep walking carefully along the path without jumping to fearful stories or forcing fake daylight.
core.zh: 月亮映照出一片能见度确实偏低的月夜地带：敏锐直觉与陈年不安共享同一片月光，雾里的轮廓常显得比实际更庞大。沿脚下小径稳步前行，既不必被恐慌脑补牵走，也不必硬装已经天亮。

message.en: Notice what feels foggy right now—separate vivid imagination and old dread from verifiable facts before making permanent calls.
message.zh: 如实承认眼下的模糊地带——在做出不可逆决定前，先将翻涌的脑补、旧担忧与确凿事实仔细剥离。

foundation.en: Subconscious fears, unspoken ambiguity, or a vivid intuitive hunch quietly shaped how this chapter developed.
foundation.zh: 潜藏在表层之下的隐忧、未说破的含糊感，或一段难以言说的敏锐直觉，悄悄塑造了如今的局势。

present.en: Not all information is in plain view yet; dreams, gut feelings, and subtle cues speak loudly, though they still require careful grounding.
present.zh: 此刻并非所有真相都已摊在阳光下；梦境、情绪波动与微妙直觉异常活跃，但仍需落地查证。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is imaginative depth and psychic sensitivity—noticing emotional undercurrents and hidden angles that purely literal minds miss.
resource.zh: 你手中最深厚的资源是共情深度与敏锐想象力——能读懂纯理性视角极易忽略的情绪暗潮与象征脉络。

challenge.en: Projection, nighttime anxiety, or half-truths are distorting the road ahead so every shadow looks like a cliff.
challenge.zh: 过度投射、深夜滋长的焦虑或残缺信息正在扭曲前路轮廓，让每一道黑影看起来都像险滩。

action.en: Verify one uncertain assumption in plain daylight, record your gut impressions without acting blindly on panic, and take only the next visible step between the towers.
action.zh: 挑一个最让你心神不宁的猜测去正面核实，记下直觉却不被恐慌推着乱动，只走眼下双塔之间看得见的那一步。

outcome.en: Ambiguity persists briefly while deeper truths surface from below; staying calm through the mist brings sharper self-knowledge than rushing ever could.
outcome.zh: 在深层真相完全浮水前，朦胧期还会持续一阵；只要在雾里稳住心神，穿越之后换来的洞察将格外深刻。

advice.en: Respect both the tame hound and the wild wolf inside you—neither dismiss genuine instincts nor let raw dread run the whole trail.
advice.zh: 兼顾内在驯顺的家犬与警觉的野狼——既不轻率否决真实的直觉警报，也不让原始恐惧接管整条夜路。

general.en: Uncertainty, heightened dreams, and hidden variables call for measured footing. Pause major bets until mist lifts and verify assumptions directly.
general.zh: 模糊变数、敏锐梦境与未明细节提示此刻宜稳不宜急。暂缓押注式大决策，先借核实让雾气慢慢散开。

love.en: In love, The Moon brings deep emotional sensitivity alongside easy misreading—old insecurities or unspoken fears can project onto a partner. Ask gently for clarity instead of filling blanks alone.
love.zh: 在感情中，月亮兼具深沉敏感与易生误读的双面性——旧日不安或未出口的猜想极易投射到伴侣身上。温和开口求证，别一个人把空白脑补成悲剧。

career.en: At work, watch for ambiguous specs, office rumors, or undisclosed shifts behind the scenes. Hold confidential plans close and double-check every assumption in writing.
career.zh: 在职场上，留意需求含糊、小道传言或幕后未公开的变动。核心筹划先守稳口风，所有关键前提都落到白纸黑字核准。

health.en: For wellbeing, sleep cycles, vivid dreams, mood tides, and subtle stress signals deserve tender attention; calm evening routines help settle an overactive imagination.
health.zh: 在身心层面，睡眠深浅、多梦波动、情绪潮汐与隐性焦虑正需要温柔照顾；安静规律的睡前节律能迅速安抚过度运转的思绪。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, this is the deep night of symbols, dreamwork, and subconscious passage—walk with curiosity rather than demanding tidy answers too soon.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，这是梦境、象征与潜意识渡河的深邃夜境——怀着敬畏与好奇同行，不必急着给每份神秘立刻贴上标准答案。

core.en: The Moon reversed signals fog beginning to thin—hidden motives or anxious illusions losing their grip, or conversely, resisting an unsettling truth that wants to come into daylight.
core.zh: 月亮逆位预示迷雾开始松动散开——隐瞒的动机与放大焦虑的幻觉逐渐显形失灵，或反过来，因害怕面对刺眼真相而仍想把自己藏回雾里。

blocked.en: Clinging to comfortable denial rather than looking straight at what the clearing mist just revealed.
blocked.zh: 雾气明明已经散开，却仍宁愿闭眼留在熟悉幻觉里，不愿直视显露出的事实。

excess.en: Spiraling into paranoid suspicion or reading conspiracies into innocent noise.
excess.zh: 陷入过度猜疑与风声鹤唳，把原本普通的杂音全都解读成暗藏算计。

internalized.en: Quietly unraveling an old fear inside and discovering it was mostly shadow all along.
internalized.zh: 在内心默默拆解掉一桩背了很久的恐惧，终于发现它原本只是被拉长的影子。

release.en: Dawn breaking through confusion—secrets surface, anxiety eases, and solid footing returns.
release.zh: 晨光劈开久积的混沌——隐情水落石出、虚惊散去，脚下重新踏上清晰实地。

challenge.en: Lingering self-deception, exposed confusion, or reluctance to trust clearing evidence is slowing your relief.
challenge.zh: 残余的自我欺骗、刚浮出水面的混乱细节，或不敢相信局势正在明朗，正在拖慢你松口气的节奏。

action.en: Turn on the lights cleanly: confront the lingering rumor, admit the awkward truth out loud, and drop the anxious storyline that no longer fits the facts.
action.zh: 干脆把灯全打开：当面戳破悬而未决的猜测、把略显尴尬却真实的现状说出来，丢掉早已不符合事实的焦虑剧本。

outcome.en: Confusion clears decisively—what was concealed comes into open view, leaving you relieved and much better equipped to choose.
outcome.zh: 迷障将干脆廓清——藏在暗处的变量全数明朗，你会长舒一口气，并拥有清晰得多的决策底气。

advice.en: Welcome plain truth even if it feels stark at first; waking from a confusing dream is always cleaner than staying half-asleep.
advice.zh: 即便最初略显直白刺眼，也要坦然迎进真相；从混沌梦境里彻底醒来，永远比半梦半醒轻松得多。

general.en: Clarity is returning after a murky stretch. Untangle half-truths calmly and release anxieties that proved far heavier in imagination than in reality.
general.zh: 熬过一段晦暗含糊后，清晰度正在回流。冷静理清似是而非的线索，放下那些只在脑海里显得可怕的虚惊。

love.en: In love, reversed Moon marks misunderstandings clearing up, hidden feelings spoken plainly, or spotting red flags you previously explained away.
love.zh: 在感情中，月亮逆位代表误会冰释、藏在心底的话终于摊开，或彻底看清此前一直替对方找借口掩饰的红灯信号。

career.en: At work, murky numbers, unspoken agendas, or project blind spots come to light—giving you a clean chance to course-correct before damage compounds.
career.zh: 在职场上，含糊的账目、暗中较劲或项目盲区开始浮出水面——正好给你趁隐患放大前果断纠偏的窗口。

health.en: Anxious fog and restless sleep begin settling once hidden stressors are named directly rather than ignored.
health.zh: 在身心层面，只要把暗中作祟的压力源直白点破而不再回避，紧绷思绪与浅睡焦虑便会明显缓解。

spirituality.en: Illusions dissolve into simple grounded presence—discernment replaces foggy mystique with quiet, testable clarity.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，虚浮的臆想正褪去并沉淀为踏实清明的当下觉知——冷静如实的辨识力取代了故弄玄虚的迷雾感。

archetypeEssence.en: Undivided daylight, warm vitality, and candid joy that thrives openly without hiding.
archetypeEssence.zh: 毫无阴霾的朗朗晴空、充沛生机与坦荡欢喜，在敞亮日光下自在绽放。

en: Radiant golden sun with serene visage casting alternating straight and wavy rays across the sky
Joyous child riding bareback with outstretched arms atop a luminous white horse
Long billowing scarlet silk banner streaming freely overhead in celebration
Low warm stone garden wall separating tidy shelter from open sunlit play
Four tall golden sunflowers turning boldly outward in abundant bloom
zh: 悬于高空、神情祥和并放射直曲相间万丈金芒的璀璨太阳
张开双臂、自在骑乘洁白骏马的欢快孩童
在晴空微风中猎猎飘扬的绯红丝绸长旗
围护花园的低矮暖石矮墙，象征安稳与敞开
越过石墙饱满盛放、热烈朝向观者的四株金色向日葵

en: Gigantic Klimt-inspired burnished antique-gold sun medallion with serene smiling visage and alternating straight and wavy rays filling the upper sky
Radiant Belle Epoque child in a light ivory tunic and floral wreath riding effortlessly astride a prancing pearl-white horse
Long billowing scarlet-vermilion silk banner lifted dynamically overhead across sunlit gold sky
Low carved limestone garden wall topped by exactly four vibrant blooming golden sunflowers facing cleanly outward
High-key molten saffron-gold and pearl-ivory illumination accented along the upper rim by deep celestial twilight indigo
zh: 占据上空、带有克里姆特鎏金质感与祥和笑颜、直曲光线交错的辉煌太阳圆轮
身着月白小衫、头戴花环、神采飞扬骑乘珠白骏马的美好年代孩童
在灿烂金光中随风舒展飘扬的炽烈绯红丝绸长幡
雕花浅石矮墙后清晰盛放、迎光舒展的四朵硕大金色向日葵
由熔金、藏红花暖光与珠白高光铺就、天际微镶靛蓝星边的朗润华彩

core.en: The Sun brings unmistakable clarity, warmth, and open-hearted success. Nothing vital needs to stay hidden in corners right now—step into full visibility, celebrate real wins generously, and let straightforward joy fuel your next chapter.
core.zh: 太阳带来毫无遮掩的清晰、暖意与坦荡成就。此刻没有必要躲在阴影里试探或缩手缩脚——大方走入阳光、真诚庆贺实在成果，让纯粹敞亮的喜悦推动下一程。

message.en: Choose simplicity, candor, and full daylight—what is true and good here shines brighter the more openly you express it.
message.zh: 选择坦率、明朗与毫无保留——眼下真正美好且扎实的事，越是大方亮出来越能大放异彩。

foundation.en: Warm support, genuine optimism, or an unambiguous past breakthrough laid bright, healthy footing underneath you.
foundation.zh: 过往真挚的善意支持、坦荡心态或一次亮堂突破，为你铺好了健康明朗的底色。

present.en: Clarity, vitality, and positive visibility peak right now; doubts dissolve quickly when brought into direct conversation.
present.zh: 清晰度、生命力与外在能见度正处高点；原本犹豫的疑惑，只要摊到明面上说清便会迎刃而解。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is radiant authenticity—warmth, optimism, and direct honesty that lift morale across the whole room.
resource.zh: 你最强的优势是坦荡感染力——发自内心的热情、爽朗与坦诚，能自然照亮并带动整个场域的士气。

challenge.en: Even upright, The Sun in a challenge slot warns against basking in easy confidence so brightly that you skim past fine details or hog the spotlight unintentionally.
challenge.zh: 即便正位，落在阻碍位的太阳也在提醒：小心因顺风顺水、光环正盛而略过细微隐患，或在无意间占满了全部聚光灯。

action.en: Put your work, feelings, or gratitude into open view today—publish, celebrate visibly, and share credit warmly with those beside you.
action.zh: 今天就大方把作品、心意或谢意亮在日光之下——发布成果、真诚庆祝，并把荣光温暖分给并肩同行的人。

outcome.en: Bright clarity, earned recognition, and heartfelt joy unfold—lingering uncertainty gives way to warm, undeniable resolution.
outcome.zh: 明朗结果、实至名归的认可与由衷欢欣即将落地——此前悬着的雾气尽散，迎来坦荡温暖的圆满节点。

advice.en: Stop shrinking to make others comfortable; shine cleanly, share warmth generously, and enjoy what you actually built.
advice.zh: 别再为了迁就气氛而刻意收起光芒；坦然发亮、慷慨传递暖意，好好享受你亲手创造的成果。

general.en: Clarity, vitality, and honest fulfillment illuminate everything you touch. Act transparently, share warmth, and welcome earned good fortune with grace.
general.zh: 清明、活力与踏实喜悦正照亮你手头的一切。光明磊落地行动，大方分享暖意，从容接住应得的好局面。

love.en: In love, The Sun radiates playful warmth, unguarded affection, and transparent trust—joyful togetherness, open communication, and mutual pride in who you are together.
love.zh: 在感情中，太阳散发炽烈温情、毫无猜忌的敞亮信赖与像孩子般自在的愉悦——彼此坦诚相待，由衷为这段并肩同行感到骄傲。

career.en: At work, expect visible breakthroughs, strong launches, clear recognition, and energizing teamwork. Step forward visibly and present your best work without downplaying its impact.
career.zh: 在事业上，预示高光突破、亮眼发布、实质嘉奖与昂扬协作。大方站到台前展示过硬作品，不必过分谦抑自己的贡献。

health.en: For wellbeing, vibrant energy, sunlight, outdoor movement, and genuine laughter replenish stamina—soak in restorative warmth while staying hydrated and well paced.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，充沛元气、自然日光、户外舒展与发自肺腑的轻松欢笑最能滋养生命力——尽情拥抱明朗活力，同时保持补水与合理节律。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, enlightenment is not austere detachment—it is unclouded presence, childlike gratitude, and wholehearted delight in ordinary light.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，觉悟从非枯槁疏离——而是清澈坦荡的临在、赤子般的感恩，以及对平凡日常之光的由衷欢喜。

core.en: The Sun reversed is sunlight filtered through passing haze—warmth and potential remain intact, yet temporary fatigue, dimmed confidence, or overblown ego is clouding full enjoyment.
core.zh: 太阳逆位好比穿过薄云的晴光——底层的暖意与好局并未消失，但暂时的疲惫、延迟到账的认可，或浮夸好胜正在遮暗本该纯粹的喜悦。

blocked.en: Good results feel muted because burnout or perfectionism won't let you actually savor them.
blocked.zh: 成果其实已经不错，却因疲惫或挑剔完美主义，迟迟无法真正高兴起来。

excess.en: Performative optimism, chasing spotlight validation, or sun-blind overconfidence ignoring real limits.
excess.zh: 刻意硬挤出的乐观、贪恋聚光灯掌声，或盲目自信忽略了脚下真实边界。

internalized.en: Quiet private warmth that you hesitate to share aloud for fear of jinxing or standing out.
internalized.zh: 心里其实藏着笃定的亮光，却怕太招眼或好景不长而不敢大方展露。

release.en: Letting go of forced cheer and spotlight pressure so simple, authentic contentment can return.
release.zh: 卸下必须时刻高光耀眼的包袱，让朴素真实的开心重新回流。

challenge.en: Temporary delays, dim self-belief, or trying too hard to look effortlessly sunny is stealing real joy.
challenge.zh: 阶段性的延迟、信心略显不足，或用力维持“一切很好”的体面，正在悄悄偷走真快乐。

action.en: Drop toxic positivity and spotlight chasing; acknowledge one genuine win already on the board and check one overlooked practical detail.
action.zh: 放下硬撑乐观与虚荣较劲；认真肯定桌上已有的那份实在成绩，再把一个容易忽略的现实细节补牢。

outcome.en: Success still arrives, simply quieter or slightly later than imagined—grounded pride outlasts flashy applause.
outcome.zh: 好结果依然会来，只是比预期稍晚一步或更低调朴实——扎实的踏实感远胜喧闹喝彩。

advice.en: You do not have to blaze at noon every day; steady morning warmth is plenty to keep growing.
advice.zh: 不必每天都像正午烈日一样耀眼；清朗平稳的晨光，早已足够万物生长。

general.en: Passing clouds are not permanent night. Ease off grand expectations, verify small blind spots, and rediscover quiet everyday enjoyment.
general.zh: 薄云掠过绝非长夜降临。调低不切实际的完美预期、补查细微盲点，重新拾起平凡日子里真切的明快感。

love.en: In love, reversed Sun flags minor ego friction, taking shared warmth for granted, or forcing cheer instead of naming a tender gripe. Small sincere appreciation restores ease fast.
love.zh: 在感情中，太阳逆位提示轻微的自尊较劲、把彼此的温暖习以为常，或强装没事掩盖小委屈。几句真诚肯定与坦率沟通很快便能拨云见日。

career.en: At work, delayed recognition, overextended enthusiasm, or polished optics masking messy execution need steady calibration. Focus on real quality over quick applause.
career.zh: 在职场上，嘉奖稍有延迟、热情透支或表面光鲜却细节松散都需要及时微调。把重心放回过硬质量，而不急着博取掌声。

health.en: Mild burnout or overexertion dims natural bounce; step back from pushing through sunny days on empty and reclaim simple daylight rest.
health.zh: 在身心层面，轻度耗竭或过度透支正压低原本的活力；别再空着电量硬撑活跃，补回朴素充足的日光与休整。

spirituality.en: Beware spiritual pride or chasing constant bliss—authentic brightness includes humble, quiet days too.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，警惕隐性优越感或执着于时刻喜悦——真正的明亮同样坦然接纳平淡安静的日子。

archetypeEssence.en: A decisive inner summons to rise into a larger life—answering truth without dragging old guilt along.
archetypeEssence.zh: 振聋发聩的内在召唤与自我觉醒——坦然清算旧账、放下愧疚，昂首迈入更开阔的人生阶段。

en: Monumental winged archangel parting bright clouds overhead sounding a long golden trumpet
Crisp white silk banner marked with a bold scarlet equal-armed cross hanging from the trumpet
Radiant sound-rays fanning downward across calm open waters toward distant icy mountains
Awakened figures rising with outstretched arms from open stone caskets floating on the sea
Expressions of unburdened release and joyous readiness answering the clear call
zh: 拨开高空云海、吹响修长金色号角的宏伟展翼大天使
垂挂于号角之下、饰有鲜明红色等臂十字的素白旗帜
自号口倾泻而下、照彻宁静海面与远方雪峰的金色声浪光束
从海上敞开的石棺中张开双臂起身的苏醒众人
卸下过往重负、神情释然且欣然回应召唤的觉醒姿态

en: Grand Belle Epoque archangel with sweeping crimson-and-gold feathered wings emerging from parted midnight-indigo clouds
Long gleaming antique-gold trumpet sounded downward draped with a crisp pearl-ivory pennant bearing an equal-armed scarlet cross
Straight golden-ivory rays of awakening light fanning across a serene star-reflected sapphire bay and distant snow-capped peaks
Three awakened human figures draped in luminous translucent ivory shrouds rising with outstretched arms from open pale-limestone sea caskets
High-contrast celestial illumination uniting scarlet-gold heavens above with radiant emerging silhouettes below
zh: 拨开深蓝云层、展开绯红鎏金宏伟双翼的美好年代大天使
向下吹响的修长古金号角与悬垂其上的珠白红十字丝幡
如乐音般洒满星光蓝海与远方皑皑雪峰的笔直金色觉醒光束
披着莹白轻纱、从海中敞开浅石棺里伸展双臂起身的三位苏醒者
上下呼应、将天界绯金辉光与海面新生剪影融为一体的壮阔明暗格局

core.en: Judgement is not a courtroom sentence—it is a wake-up trumpet. Take clear, merciful stock of what past chapters taught you, forgive what kept you small, and answer the larger calling that has been knocking unmistakably at your door.
core.zh: 审判不是冰冷定罪，而是唤醒沉睡的号角。清醒而仁慈地盘点过往每一段历练，宽恕那些曾把你困在窄处的旧错，然后干脆回应门外那声已清晰响起的更高召唤。

message.en: Answer the call you can no longer unhear—own your past cleanly, release old shame, and step up to the bigger role ready for you.
message.zh: 回应那声你已再也装作听不见的内在召唤——坦然整合过往、卸下陈旧愧疚，站上早已为你敞开的更大舞台。

foundation.en: A pivotal reckoning, honest milestone review, or wake-up realization shook loose old sleepwalking and sparked this new chapter.
foundation.zh: 一次关键的自我清算、重要节点复盘或醍醐灌顶的顿悟，摇醒了过往惯性，开启了当下的新局面。

present.en: You are standing in a clear moment of evaluation and graduation: past efforts are being tallied honestly, and a fresh tier of purpose is opening.
present.zh: 你正处在一场清晰的阶段考核与跃升关口：过往积累正被如实检阅，更高一层的人生格局正在面前展开。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is redeemed experience—nothing you survived was wasted once you integrate its lesson and let it fuel your calling.
resource.zh: 你最厚重的资本是历经锤炼且被真正消化的阅历——凡是走过的弯路，只要提炼出真知，全都会成为托举你跃升的底气。

challenge.en: Even upright, Judgement in a challenge slot highlights the nerve required to outgrow an old self-image—rising means letting past critics and old excuses stay behind in the box.
challenge.zh: 即便正位，落在阻碍位的审判也指向挣脱旧自我定位所需的胆识——起身迎新，就必须把过往的标签、苛责与借口留在旧盒子里。

action.en: Make the decisive call you have been circling, forgive one lingering self-reproach, and step openly into the next chapter with both arms lifted.
action.zh: 做出那个你已反复盘旋的关键抉择，正式原谅自己一桩耿耿于怀的旧憾，张开双臂坦然迈入下一程。

outcome.en: Profound renewal, absolution, and a clean graduation into a truer life stage arrive—you emerge lighter, clearer, and deeply aligned.
outcome.zh: 深沉的焕新、彻底释怀与顺理成章的进阶跃升将落定——你会以更轻盈、更笃定的姿态站上全新高度。

advice.en: Judge your past to harvest wisdom, never to sentence your future—rise when the trumpet sounds.
advice.zh: 复盘过往是为了提炼智慧，绝不是为了替未来判刑——号角已经响起，果断起身迎光。

general.en: Awakening, honest integration, and a defining call to grow mark this moment. Release outdated guilt and step wholeheartedly into what comes next.
general.zh: 觉醒、诚实整合与标志性的成长召唤正落在此刻。放下过时的内疚包袱，全心跨入人生的下一段开阔格局。

love.en: In love, Judgement brings a decisive turning point—honest forgiveness and true rebirth inside a committed bond, or waking clearly to the kind of partnership your whole self actually deserves.
love.zh: 在感情中，审判标志关系迎来清晰分水岭——要么在彻底坦白与宽恕中获得重生升级，要么彻底醒悟，奔向真正配得上你完整灵魂的伴侣模式。

career.en: At work, this signals a true vocational calling, promotion review, graduation, or decisive leap from 'just a job' into work that carries unmistakable personal meaning.
career.zh: 在事业上，它呼应真正的志业召唤、关键晋升评审、阶段出师，或从单纯谋生果断跃迁向真正有个人分量的事业轨道。

health.en: For wellbeing, a wake-up realization sparks lasting renewal—dropping old self-neglect cleanly and committing to vital living without looking back.
health.zh: 在身心层面，一次彻底清醒的顿悟会开启持久焕新——干脆告别旧日消耗惯性，不留恋地拥抱更有生命力的日常。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, this is genuine resurrection of purpose: answering conscience wholeheartedly and discovering grace through honest self-forgiveness.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，这是初心与使命的真正复活：毫无保留地回应内在良知，并在诚实的自我宽恕里体会真正的松绑。

core.en: Judgement reversed shows the call being put on snooze—harsh inner self-criticism, fear of being judged by others, or stubbornly ignoring a wake-up signal you already heard loud and clear.
core.zh: 审判逆位映照出把唤醒闹钟一再按掉的回避——严苛的自我批判、过度在意他人评判，或明明早已听清转折信号却仍迟疑着不肯起身。

blocked.en: Self-doubt and fear of making the wrong call keep you crouching inside an outgrown box.
blocked.zh: 自我怀疑与怕选错的包袱，把你死死按在早已装不下自己的旧格子里。

excess.en: Relentless self-condemnation or nitpicking everyone else's flaws to dodge your own next step.
excess.zh: 没完没了地自我审判，或盯着旁人毛病评头论足，借此逃避自己该迈出的下一步。

internalized.en: Privately hearing the pull toward a bigger life while telling yourself you missed your window.
internalized.zh: 心里明明一遍遍听见更大人生的召唤，嘴上却不断告诉自己已经错过窗口。

release.en: Silencing the harsh inner prosecutor so honest self-compassion finally lets you move forward.
release.zh: 让内心那个尖刻的检察官闭嘴，在温和坦诚的自我接纳里重新迈开脚步。

challenge.en: Chronic self-doubt, old regret, or fear of outside judgment is drowning out a clear inner invitation.
challenge.zh: 挥之不去的自责、陈年懊悔或对旁人眼光的畏惧，正盖过内心原本清亮的召唤。

action.en: Write down the mistake you keep replaying, extract its single practical lesson, forgive yourself formally, and answer the opportunity you have been dodging.
action.zh: 写下那件你总在心里反复翻旧账的失误，只提炼出一条实在教训，正式翻篇宽恕自己，再去回应那个你一直闪躲的机会。

outcome.en: Hesitation only stretches the waiting room; the moment you stop rehearsing old guilt, the stalled breakthrough unlocks cleanly.
outcome.zh: 犹豫只会拉长原地打转的候场时间；只要停止拿旧账惩罚自己，停滞的突破很快便会豁然开朗。

advice.en: Stop waiting for perfect absolution from outside critics—your real calling does not expire just because you stumbled earlier.
advice.zh: 别再等外界评委给你发完美通行证——你真正想走的路，绝不会因为从前跌过一跤就作废。

general.en: Notice where harsh self-judgment or fear of scrutiny is holding back an overdue leap. Drop old guilt and answer your honest next step.
general.zh: 觉察严苛的自审或对他人评价的担忧，正把哪场早该启动的跃迁按在原地。放下陈旧愧疚，诚实回应下一个阶段。

love.en: In love, reversed Judgement warns against replaying past heartbreaks as permanent verdicts, nitpicking a partner, or avoiding a candid decision about a relationship's true viability.
love.zh: 在感情中，审判逆位提醒别把过往情伤当成终身定论、也别在琐碎挑剔中消耗彼此，更不要继续回避对关系前景的诚实判断。

career.en: At work, imposter syndrome, fear of evaluation, or ignoring clear feedback that a chapter has peaked stalls advancement. Take honest notes without personalizing critique.
career.zh: 在职场上，冒牌者心理、畏惧考核，或回避“某段路径已到天花板”的清晰反馈，都会拖住跃升。客观吸收建议，别把业务复盘变成自我否定。

health.en: Ignoring persistent wake-up signals—or beating yourself up for past slips—slows recovery; drop the guilt and start clean from today.
health.zh: 在身心层面，无视身体反复发出的提醒，或为过去疏于照顾自己而苛责懊恼，都会拖慢复原；放下自责，从今天清爽重启。

spirituality.en: Forgiveness is the missing hinge: no genuine awakening grows out of self-contempt.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，对自己与过往的宽恕正是那枚缺失的枢纽：真正的内在觉醒从来不会从无休止的自我嫌弃里长出来。

Radiant straight rays of golden-ivory light fan downward from the trumpet bell across a serene, star-reflected sapphire bay backed by pale snow-capped mountain peaks along the distant horizon. Rising joyfully with outstretched arms from THREE open pale-limestone caskets floating gently on the luminous sea are THREE awakened human figures draped in soft translucent pearl-ivory shrouds—a woman, a man, and a youth—faces lifted skyward in luminous release and wonder. Crisp golden illumination ties the majestic winged archangel above directly to the radiant rising figures below with unmistakable vertical grandeur.
