long golden trumpet draped with scarlet-cross ivory pennant
awakened rising human figures in open sea caskets

promptSpec.compositionNote: Grand vertical call-and-response: crimson-gold winged archangel and bright vertical golden trumpet filling the upper half above glowing golden rays and three outstretched rising ivory silhouettes below—reads vividly at 64x96 thumbnail.

archetypeEssence.en: Integrated wholeness—completing a full spiral with mastery, grace, and readiness for wider horizons.
archetypeEssence.zh: 浑然圆融的整全与大成——以从容驾驭收束一整轮历程，坦然面向更辽阔的新螺旋。

en: Serene dancing figure poised weightlessly at the center of a great oval laurel wreath
Lush emerald victory wreath tied top and bottom with flowing crimson infinity ribbons
Lightweight silk scarf draping gracefully across the dancer's balanced silhouette
Two short slender batons held evenly in each hand signifying equilibrium in motion
Four winged celestial corner emblems—angel, eagle, bull, and lion—framing the completed cosmos
zh: 凌空舒展、轻盈起舞于巨型椭圆月桂花环中央的从容舞者
上下两端皆系着绯红无限结丝带的繁茂翠绿胜利花环
随舞姿优雅拂过身侧的飘逸轻纱
双手各执一根纤细权杖，象征动静平衡与圆融掌控
镇守四隅云端、象征四元素圆满归位的天使、苍鹰、圣牛与雄狮

en: Radiant Belle Epoque dancer floating weightlessly inside a luminous halo at the center of a starry midnight-indigo firmament
Grand oval Art Nouveau wreath woven from lustrous emerald laurel leaves and gilded berries, bound top and bottom with sweeping scarlet-crimson silk infinity ribbons
Billowing royal-amethyst and pearl-ivory silk scarf draped gracefully across the dancer holding exactly two slender burnished-gold equilibrium batons
Four serene winged celestial corner emblems—angel, eagle, winged bull, and winged lion—framed symmetrically inside golden cloud medallions
Radiant ivory-gold central aura contrasting opulently against deep cosmic midnight indigo and emerald laurel foliage
zh: 在深邃星穹中央暖金光晕中轻盈旋舞的美好年代舞者
由光泽饱满的祖母绿月桂叶与鎏金浆果编成、上下系有绯红丝绸无限结的宏伟椭圆花环
身披紫晶与月白流动丝巾、双手各轻握一根古金平衡短杖的舒展身姿
对称镶嵌在四角暖金云纹徽章中的四尊展翼星界圣灵（天使、苍鹰、翼牛、翼狮）
在深沉星夜靛青与翠绿月桂间璀璨绽放的象牙金圆满光辉

core.en: The World marks genuine completion: the disparate lessons of a long cycle have finally clicked into one coherent whole. Honor the milestone fully, take a bow with quiet pride, and know you are ready to step into a much larger arena.
core.zh: 世界标志货真价实的圆满收官：漫长历程里散落各处的功课终于严丝合缝地汇成整体。郑重致敬这份里程碑、从容收下应得的喝彩，你已具备踏入更广阔世界舞台的完整底气。

message.en: Finish the final seam cleanly and claim your graduation—this chapter is genuinely complete, and wider doors are already swinging open.
message.zh: 把最后一道收尾稳稳做圆，大方认领你的出师时刻——这一程已真正圆满，更广阔的门正为你敞开。

foundation.en: Broad experience, completed past cycles, or hard-won integration across multiple areas built the mastery you stand on now.
foundation.zh: 丰富的跨界历练、圆满收官的过往周期，以及多方经验的融会贯通，共同托起了如今的从容底气。

present.en: Pieces are clicking cleanly into place; you are experiencing real wholeness, global perspective, and satisfying closure on a major endeavor.
present.zh: 所有拼图正严丝合缝地归位；你正体会着难得的整全感、辽阔视野，以及重要长线事项圆满合拢的踏实。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is panoramic synthesis—combining intellect, heart, willpower, and craft seamlessly so you feel at home anywhere.
resource.zh: 你最强的底气是全局融通力——把理智、共情、意志与实操无缝合一，无论走到哪片天地都能游刃有余。

challenge.en: Even upright, The World in a challenge slot highlights the quiet vertigo right after finishing a big chapter—don't linger endlessly polishing a complete work just to avoid beginning the next spiral.
challenge.zh: 即便正位，落在阻碍位的世界也点出抵达巅峰后那一丝微妙悬空感——别因为还没想好下一程去哪，就反复擦拭一件早已圆满的作品不肯交付。

action.en: Ship the final deliverable, celebrate the full journey deliberately, and orient toward broader horizons—travel, international collaboration, or a bigger scope.
action.zh: 把最终成果正式交付封卷，郑重办一场属于自己的结业庆祝，随后把目光投向更宽广的版图——远行、跨界合作或更大格局。

outcome.en: Fulfillment, well-earned mastery, and harmonious completion arrive—closing a meaningful era with poise and opening the gateway to a richer next cycle.
outcome.zh: 丰盈圆满、实至名归的掌控感与优雅收官即将到来——一段重要岁月从容合卷，更丰盛的新周期随即启幕。

advice.en: Move like the dancer inside the wreath: stay light on your feet even at the summit, because mastery is an ongoing rhythm rather than a static trophy.
advice.zh: 像花环中央轻盈起舞的人一样保持灵动：即便站上巅峰也不僵硬自满，真正的圆满是生生不息的流转，而非停步不前的奖杯。

general.en: Wholeness, completion, and expanded horizons crown this period. Tie up the final ribbon cleanly, savor what you achieved, and welcome a wider world.
general.zh: 整全、大成与辽阔新视野为这段时期加冕。利落系好最后一道收尾丝带，坦然享受所成，从容步入更宽广的天地。

love.en: In love, The World speaks of deep mutual fulfillment, feeling genuinely 'home' with each other, or completing an important chapter together—long-distance bridging, shared travel, or mature harmony.
love.zh: 在感情中，世界象征高度契合的归属感与“彼此即是归宿”的安稳圆融——或共同完成人生重要里程碑，跨越距离、同行远方，在成熟默契里相得益彰。

career.en: At work, expect major project completion, international or cross-market reach, formal graduation, or stepping into full mastery of your craft. Package the finished body of work boldly.
career.zh: 在事业上，预示重大项目圆满上线、跨地域或国际化拓展、学业与阶段大考出师，或彻底站稳行业纯熟高度。自信呈现你的完整代表作。

health.en: For wellbeing, mind, body, and daily rhythm feel genuinely integrated—vitality thrives through balanced whole-life stewardship and joyful active movement.
health.zh: 在身心层面，身心节律与生活秩序进入圆融顺畅的整合态——全盘均衡的养护与愉悦舒展的活动让生命力饱满通透。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, integration arrives not by escaping the world but by dancing cleanly inside it—belonging to the whole cosmos with humility and delight.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，真正的圆融不在抽离尘世，而在万象之中轻盈起舞——怀着谦卑与喜悦，体会自己本就与广阔天地浑然一体。

core.en: The World reversed signals an almost-finished cycle missing its final 5%—leaving loose ends untied, cutting corners at the finish line, or hesitating to declare an era done.
core.zh: 世界逆位提示一整轮历程恰恰停在最后百分之五的收口处——留着没扎紧的线头、临门一脚略显草率，或因迟疑而不敢正式宣布这一章彻底完结。

blocked.en: An unfinished detail or lingering tie keeps a major chapter from closing cleanly.
blocked.zh: 一处悬而未决的细节或未了牵挂，卡住了整段重要周期的利落收尾。

excess.en: Skipping final closure out of impatience to sprint straight into the next shiny project.
excess.zh: 急着冲向下一个新鲜目标，草草略过了本该郑重完成的收口与复盘。

internalized.en: Downplaying real accomplishments because the last tiny flaw looms larger in your head than the whole journey.
internalized.zh: 紧盯着最后那一点微小瑕疵，反而抹杀了整趟长途积累下来的真实成就。

release.en: Tying off the final loose thread consciously so delayed completion finally lands in peace.
release.zh: 有意识地把最后那根散落线头亲手系紧，让迟到的圆满终于安稳落地。

challenge.en: Unfinished business, shortcuts on the final stretch, or reluctance to close an old loop is blocking full satisfaction.
challenge.zh: 未清的收尾事项、冲线前的偷懒抄近路，或不肯为旧周期合卷，正拦着你体会真正的圆满感。

action.en: List the exact two or three remaining loose ends today and close them completely—no shortcuts—before starting anything brand new.
action.zh: 今天就列出最后剩下的两三处未了尾项，不走捷径地彻底收干净，之后再启新局。

outcome.en: Completion is still within arm's reach, just waiting on patient follow-through; finishing the last inch properly delivers the whole reward.
outcome.zh: 圆满仍触手可及，只差耐心走完最后那一寸；踏实做好收口，整份成果的丰厚回馈就会完整落袋。

advice.en: Respect the final five percent—clean closure honors everything you already invested and frees your hands for what comes next.
advice.zh: 敬重最后百分之五的收官功夫——干脆体面的闭环既不辜负此前的全部心血，也能彻底腾出双手迎接新世界。

general.en: You are nearly across the finish line, but a few untied threads still need attention. Finish cleanly rather than abandoning the work at ninety-five percent.
general.zh: 你离终点线只剩一步之遥，只是还有几处线头需要亲手收紧。别停在九十五分就急着转身，稳稳把最后一段画圆。

love.en: In love, reversed World flags unfinished emotional closure from an earlier chapter, or a relationship hovering right before deeper commitment until one lingering hesitation is addressed.
love.zh: 在感情中，世界逆位提示前段情感尚未彻底收尾，或眼下的关系正停在迈向更深承诺的门槛前，需要把那点悬着的心结坦诚理清。

career.en: At work, final QA, documentation, handoffs, or formal launch steps are overdue. Close the last mile thoroughly so the whole project earns its full credit.
career.zh: 在职场上，收尾验收、文档归档、交接或正式发布步骤早已到期。把最后一公里扎扎实实收完，整场心血才配得上完整口碑。

health.en: Stopping a recovery protocol the moment symptoms ease invites relapse; finish the complete course patiently so gains actually lock in.
health.zh: 在身心调理上，症状刚见好就中途停掉巩固方案容易反复；耐心走完完整周期，好状态才会真正稳固下来。

spirituality.en: Don't rush past gratitude and integration into the next quest; pause to name what this whole cycle actually taught you.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，别急着略过感恩与沉淀就奔赴下一场追寻；停下来认真说出这整轮经历究竟教会了你什么。

Poised weightlessly inside the brightly illuminated central oval dances ONE serene, radiant Belle Epoque figure draped in a flowing royal-amethyst and pearl-ivory silk scarf, one knee lightly bent in poised equilibrium while each hand grasps ONE slender burnished antique-gold equilibrium baton (two batons total). Resting symmetrically within glowing golden cloud-medallions at the four corners appear EXACTLY FOUR serene winged celestial emblems—an angel at upper-left, an eagle at upper-right, a winged bull at lower-left, and a winged lion at lower-right—completing the grand cosmic mandala. Brilliant ivory-gold halo light behind the dancer contrasts vividly against the emerald laurel ring and velvety cosmic indigo.
